+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
+#
+# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
+# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
+# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
+# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
+# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
+#
+# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
+# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
+# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
+#
+# Derived fields:
+#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
+#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
+#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
+#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
+#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
+#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
+#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
+#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
+#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
+#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
+#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
+#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
+#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
+#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
+#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
+#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
+#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
+#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
+#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
+#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
+#
+# Usage:
+#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
+#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
+#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
+#
+# Options:
+#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
+#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
+#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
+#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
+#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
+#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
+#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
+#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
+#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
+#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
+#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
+#                      bad row naming its line number
+#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
+#
+# Exit codes:
+#   0  row written / file valid
+#   1  --validate found a bad row
+#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
+# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
+# =============================================================================
+set -euo pipefail
+export LC_ALL=C
+
+RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
+VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
+usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
+    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
+    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
+  esac
+done
+
+STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
+
+# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
+  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
+  n=0 bad=0
+  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
+    n=$((n + 1))
+    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
+    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
+      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
+      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
+                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
+                       else empty end;
+      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
+      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
+      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
+      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
+        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
+        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
+        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
+        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
+        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
+        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
+        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
+        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
+        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
+        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
+        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
+        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
+        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
+      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
+           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
+      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
+      // (if (.zone_violations.dot_claude_writes | type) != "array" then "zone_violations.dot_claude_writes is not an array" else empty end)
+      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
+      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
+           then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
+      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
+           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
+      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
+           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
+               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
+                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
+                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
+                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
+                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
+                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
+                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
+      // (if $ungraded then empty
+          elif (["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","contaminated"] | index($row.status)) == null then empty
+          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
+            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
+          else
+            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
+               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
+          end)
+      // empty
+      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
+    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
+      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
+      exit 1
+    fi
+  done < "$VALIDATE"
+  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
+[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
+[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
+PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
+[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
+jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
+[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
+if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
+  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
+fi
+[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
+GRADE_JSON=null
+if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
+  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
+  GRADE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$GRADE")" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
+fi
+MAN_JSON='{}'
+if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
+  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
+  MAN_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST")" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
+fi
+TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
+PIPE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$PIPE")"
+RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")"
+
+# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
+META_ARM=""
+[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
+MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' <<<"$MAN_JSON")"
+if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
+  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
+fi
+ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")}}"
+[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"
+
+# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
+MINV='[]'
+if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
+  MINV="$(awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
+          | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
+                         | select(.row != null)]')"
+fi
+
+envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
+  local f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
+  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
+  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
+}
+ENV_REVIEW="$(envelope review)"
+ENV_AUDIT="$(envelope audit)"
+
+# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
+DOT_WRITES='[]'
+shopt -s nullglob
+ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
+shopt -u nullglob
+if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
+  DOT_WRITES="$(for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
+      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
+      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
+        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
+                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
+        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
+        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
+    done | jq -s -c '.')"
+fi
+
+ROW="$(jq -n -c \
+  --argjson p "$PIPE_JSON" --argjson task "$TASK_JSON" --argjson g "$GRADE_JSON" --argjson m "$MAN_JSON" \
+  --argjson minv "$MINV" --argjson er "$ENV_REVIEW" --argjson ea "$ENV_AUDIT" --argjson dot "$DOT_WRITES" \
+  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
+  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
+  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
+  def ms(ts): if ts == null then null else (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) end;
+  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
+      {planned: (e.verdict_quality.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
+       completed: (e.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
+       quality: (e.verdict_quality.status // e.status // null),
+       companion_planned: e.metadata.companion_voice.planned} end;
+  ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
+  | [ $ran[] as $ph
+      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
+      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
+      | $ph + {
+          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
+          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
+          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
+                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
+                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
+                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
+          model_mismatches: [ ($ph.models_used // {}) | keys[] | select((. | norm_model) != ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) ]
+        } ] as $phases
+  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
+        | .model_requested as $req
+        | ( .model_mismatches[] | "\($l): model \(.) used, \($req) requested" ),
+          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
+          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
+      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
+          | voices($e) as $v
+          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
+            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
+                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
+    ) as $why
+  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
+  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
+     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
+     else $pst end) as $status
+  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
+  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
+  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
+  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
+  | {
+      schema_version: 1,
+      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
+      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
+      arm: $arm,
+      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
+      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
+      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
+      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
+      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
+      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
+      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
+      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
+      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
+      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),
+      started: ($p.started // ""),
+      finished: ($p.finished // null),
+      phases: [ $phases[] | {name, label, session_id, model_requested, models_used, effort_requested, effort_effective,
+                             tokens_in: (.tokens_in // 0), tokens_out: (.tokens_out // 0),
+                             cache_read_tokens: (.cache_read_tokens // 0), cache_creation_tokens: (.cache_creation_tokens // 0),
+                             cost_usd: (.cost_usd // 0), voice_cost_usd, ledger_cost_usd: (.ledger_cost_usd // 0),
+                             duration_ms: (.duration_ms // 0), num_turns: (.num_turns // 0), exit: (.exit // -1),
+                             timed_out: (.timed_out // false), refusal_fallbacks: (.refusal_fallbacks // []),
+                             snapshot: (.snapshot // null), verdict: (.verdict // null)} ],
+      voices_run: (if $er == null and $ea == null then null else {review: voices($er), audit: voices($ea)} end),
+      hidden_tests: $ht,
+      hidden_test_pass_rate: (if $ht == null or $ht.total == 0 then null else ($ht.passed / $ht.total) end),
+      defects_seeded: $seeded,
+      defects_caught: $caught,
+      defect_catch_rate: (if $rc == null then null
+                          else ($rc.recall // $rc.rate // $rc.defect_catch_rate
+                                // (if $seeded != null and $seeded > 0 and $caught != null then $caught / $seeded else null end)) end),
+      flags: ($rc.flags // $g.flags // null),
+      false_positives: ($g.false_positives // null | if type == "array" then length else . end),
+      verdict: ($g.verdict | if type == "object" then .value else . end // null),
+      verdict_accuracy: ($g.verdict_accuracy | if type == "object" then .value else . end),
+      verdict_accuracy_review: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_review | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_review
+                                else $g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate.review end),
+      verdict_accuracy_audit: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_audit | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_audit
+                               else $g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate.audit end),
+      regressions: ($g.regressions // null | if type == "object" then ((.newly_failing // []) | length)
+                                            elif type == "array" then length else . end),
+      diff_lines: ($g.diff_lines // null),
+      files_changed: ($g.files_changed // null),
+      cost_usd: ([$phases[] | (.cost_usd // 0) + (.ledger_cost_usd // 0)] | add // 0),
+      wall_clock_ms: (if $p.started != null and $p.finished != null then (ms($p.finished) - ms($p.started))
+                      else ([$phases[] | .wall_ms // .duration_ms // 0] | add // 0) end),
+      tokens_in: ([$phases[] | .tokens_in // 0] | add // 0),
+      tokens_out: ([$phases[] | .tokens_out // 0] | add // 0),
+      stalls: ([$phases[] | select(.timed_out == true)] | length),
+      attempts: $attempts,
+      retry_reason: (if $retry_reason == "" then null else $retry_reason end),
+      degraded: (($why | length) > 0),
+      degraded_reason: (if ($why | length) == 0 then null else ($why | join("; ")) end),
+      status: $status,
+      cap_phase: ($p.cap_phase // null),
+      snapshots: {implement: ($p.snapshots.implement // null), fix1: ($p.snapshots.fix1 // null), fix2: ($p.snapshots.fix2 // null)},
+      contaminated: ($g.contaminated // null | if type == "object" then {phase: (.phase // null), pattern: (.pattern // null)} else null end),
+      zone_violations: {dot_claude_writes: $dot}
+    }')"
+
+if [[ -n "$OUT" ]]; then
+  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
+  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    { flock -x 9; printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"; } 9>>"$OUT.lock"
+  else
+    printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"
+  fi
+else
+  printf '%s\n' "$ROW"
+fi

+# Dockerfile.ablation — container executor image for the cycle-130 component ablation
+# (SDD D-4.9 / DEC-0411). Extends Dockerfile.sandbox's pinned base and non-root user
+# with the Claude Code CLI, the codex CLI, pytest and bats. It holds NO credentials.
+# pipeline-run.sh mounts exactly two host paths: the sandbox read-write at /workspace
+# and a per-run writable HOME at /home/evaluser (<run>/meta/home: the codex CLI's
+# auth.json/config.toml copies, empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store). The
+# Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK passed in the environment.
+# The image's tool versions (below) are the batch's versions: every arm runs here.
+#
+# Build (no build context is needed; nothing is COPY'd):
+#   docker build -t loa-ablation:258 - < evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation
+# Run:
+#   evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh --executor container --image loa-ablation:258 …
+#   (pipeline-run.sh passes --rm --name --user --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp
+#    --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2 and exactly the two mounts)
+#
+# Digest pinned 2026-02-11 (same base as Dockerfile.sandbox):
+#   docker manifest inspect node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim | jq '.manifests[0].digest'
+FROM rust:1-bookworm AS brbuild
+RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br --locked 2>/dev/null || cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br
+
+FROM node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim@sha256:8ea90c4f037cc3c2f566eb46c53eaac005129113487eda4090058fe554578104 AS base
+
+ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.299
+ARG CODEX_VERSION=0.162.1
+ARG PYTEST_VERSION=9.0.2
+ARG BATS_VERSION=v1.13.0
+
+RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
+    bash \
+    git \
+    jq \
+    python3 \
+    python3-pip \
+    python3-venv \
+    grep \
+    diffutils \
+    coreutils \
+    procps \
+    ca-certificates \
+    curl \
+    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+
+# yq (mikefarah/yq) with SHA256 integrity verification (as Dockerfile.sandbox)
+ARG YQ_VERSION=v4.40.5
+ARG YQ_SHA256_AMD64=0d6aaf1cf44a8d18fbc7ed0ef14f735a8df8d2e314c4cc0f0242d35c0a440c95
+ARG YQ_SHA256_ARM64=9431f0fa39a0af03a152d7fe19a86e42e9ff28d503ed4a70598f9261ec944a97
+RUN arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
+    case "$arch" in \
+      amd64) yq_arch="amd64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_AMD64}" ;; \
+      arm64) yq_arch="arm64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_ARM64}" ;; \
+      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" && exit 1 ;; \
+    esac && \
+    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_${yq_arch}" \
+      -o /usr/local/bin/yq && \
+    echo "${yq_sha256}  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c - && \
+    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq
+
+# The two CLIs at the versions the fingerprint pins (exact versions, no ranges).
+RUN npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit \
+      "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}" \
+      "@openai/codex@${CODEX_VERSION}" \
+    && npm cache clean --force
+
+# pytest for Python fixtures (bookworm's pip is externally managed)
+RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "pytest==${PYTEST_VERSION}"
+# cheval's declared dependencies (.claude/adapters/pyproject.toml: dependencies + the `full` extra),
+# so the sandbox gates (adversarial-review.sh, flatline-orchestrator.sh) can dispatch (lead, DEC-0482)
+RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "rfc8785>=0.1.4" "jsonschema>=4.21" "pyyaml>=6.0" "httpx[http2]>=0.24.0"
+
+# bats-core at the pinned tag
+RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BATS_VERSION}" https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core.git /tmp/bats-core && \
+    /tmp/bats-core/install.sh /usr/local && \
+    rm -rf /tmp/bats-core
+
+# Disable npm lifecycle scripts for anything the agent installs later
+RUN npm config set ignore-scripts true
+
+# Non-root user (as Dockerfile.sandbox). At run time /home/evaluser is replaced by the
+# per-run HOME bind mount and the process runs as the host uid (--user).
+RUN groupadd -r evaluser && useradd -r -g evaluser -d /home/evaluser -s /bin/bash evaluser
+# No beads (br) in the image: beads_rust 0.2.6 is not on crates.io and the host binary needs glibc 2.38+; the sandbox
+# materialiser writes the beads opt-out marker (LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN unset/absent), so every arm runs the skills'
+# markdown fallback alike (lead, Sprint 258).
+RUN mkdir -p /home/evaluser/.aws /home/evaluser/.claude /home/evaluser/.codex /workspace && \
+    chown -R evaluser:evaluser /home/evaluser /workspace
+
+ENV TZ=UTC
+ENV LC_ALL=C
+ENV HOME=/home/evaluser
+ENV NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true
+ENV CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1
+
+USER evaluser
+WORKDIR /workspace
+
+# Health check — every tool the fingerprint names is present
+RUN bash --version && git --version && jq --version && node --version && \
+    python3 --version && python3 -m pytest --version && yq --version && \
+    bats --version && claude --version && codex --version && \
+    echo "All tools verified"
+
+ENTRYPOINT []
+CMD ["/bin/bash"]

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
+#
+# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
+# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
+# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
+# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
+# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
+#
+# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
+# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
+# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
+#
+# Derived fields:
+#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
+#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
+#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
+#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
+#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
+#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
+#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
+#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
+#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
+#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
+#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
+#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
+#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
+#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
+#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
+#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
+#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
+#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
+#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
+#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
+#
+# Usage:
+#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
+#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
+#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
+#
+# Options:
+#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
+#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
+#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
+#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
+#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
+#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
+#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
+#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
+#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
+#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
+#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
+#                      bad row naming its line number
+#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
+#
+# Exit codes:
+#   0  row written / file valid
+#   1  --validate found a bad row
+#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
+# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
+# =============================================================================
+set -euo pipefail
+export LC_ALL=C
+
+RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
+VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
+usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
+    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
+    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
+  esac
+done
+
+STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
+
+# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
+  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
+  n=0 bad=0
+  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
+    n=$((n + 1))
+    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
+    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
+      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
+      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
+                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
+                       else empty end;
+      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
+      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
+      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
+      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
+        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
+        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
+        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
+        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
+        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
+        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
+        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
+        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
+        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
+        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
+        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
+        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
+        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
+      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
+           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
+      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
+      // (if (.zone_violations.dot_claude_writes | type) != "array" then "zone_violations.dot_claude_writes is not an array" else empty end)
+      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
+      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
+           then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
+      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
+           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
+      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
+           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
+               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
+                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
+                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
+                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
+                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
+                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
+                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
+      // (if $ungraded then empty
+          elif (["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","contaminated"] | index($row.status)) == null then empty
+          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
+            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
+          else
+            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
+               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
+          end)
+      // empty
+      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
+    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
+      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
+      exit 1
+    fi
+  done < "$VALIDATE"
+  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
+[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
+[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
+PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
+[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
+jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
+[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
+if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
+  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
+fi
+[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
+GRADE_JSON=null
+if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
+  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
+  GRADE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$GRADE")" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
+fi
+MAN_JSON='{}'
+if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
+  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
+  MAN_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST")" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
+fi
+TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
+PIPE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$PIPE")"
+RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")"
+
+# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
+META_ARM=""
+[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
+MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' <<<"$MAN_JSON")"
+if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
+  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
+fi
+ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")}}"
+[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"
+
+# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
+MINV='[]'
+if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
+  MINV="$(awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
+          | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
+                         | select(.row != null)]')"
+fi
+
+envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
+  local f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
+  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
+  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
+}
+ENV_REVIEW="$(envelope review)"
+ENV_AUDIT="$(envelope audit)"
+
+# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
+DOT_WRITES='[]'
+shopt -s nullglob
+ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
+shopt -u nullglob
+if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
+  DOT_WRITES="$(for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
+      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
+      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
+        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
+                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
+        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
+        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
+    done | jq -s -c '.')"
+fi
+
+ROW="$(jq -n -c \
+  --argjson p "$PIPE_JSON" --argjson task "$TASK_JSON" --argjson g "$GRADE_JSON" --argjson m "$MAN_JSON" \
+  --argjson minv "$MINV" --argjson er "$ENV_REVIEW" --argjson ea "$ENV_AUDIT" --argjson dot "$DOT_WRITES" \
+  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
+  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
+  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
+  def ms(ts): if ts == null then null else (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) end;
+  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
+      {planned: (e.verdict_quality.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
+       completed: (e.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
+       quality: (e.verdict_quality.status // e.status // null),
+       companion_planned: e.metadata.companion_voice.planned} end;
+  ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
+  | [ $ran[] as $ph
+      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
+      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
+      | $ph + {
+          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
+          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
+          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
+                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
+                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
+                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
+          model_mismatches: [ ($ph.models_used // {}) | keys[] | select((. | norm_model) != ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) ]
+        } ] as $phases
+  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
+        | .model_requested as $req
+        | ( .model_mismatches[] | "\($l): model \(.) used, \($req) requested" ),
+          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
+          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
+      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
+          | voices($e) as $v
+          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
+            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
+                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
+    ) as $why
+  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
+  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
+     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
+     else $pst end) as $status
+  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
+  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
+  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
+  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
+  | {
+      schema_version: 1,
+      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
+      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
+      arm: $arm,
+      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
+      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
+      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
+      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
+      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
+      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
+      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
+      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
+      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
+      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),
+      started: ($p.started // ""),
+      finished: ($p.finished // null),
+      phases: [ $phases[] | {name, label, session_id, model_requested, models_used, effort_requested, effort_effective,
+                             tokens_in: (.tokens_in // 0), tokens_out: (.tokens_out // 0),
+                             cache_read_tokens: (.cache_read_tokens // 0), cache_creation_tokens: (.cache_creation_tokens // 0),
+                             cost_usd: (.cost_usd // 0), voice_cost_usd, ledger_cost_usd: (.ledger_cost_usd // 0),
+                             duration_ms: (.duration_ms // 0), num_turns: (.num_turns // 0), exit: (.exit // -1),
+                             timed_out: (.timed_out // false), refusal_fallbacks: (.refusal_fallbacks // []),
+                             snapshot: (.snapshot // null), verdict: (.verdict // null)} ],
+      voices_run: (if $er == null and $ea == null then null else {review: voices($er), audit: voices($ea)} end),
+      hidden_tests: $ht,
+      hidden_test_pass_rate: (if $ht == null or $ht.total == 0 then null else ($ht.passed / $ht.total) end),
+      defects_seeded: $seeded,
+      defects_caught: $caught,
+      defect_catch_rate: (if $rc == null then null
+                          else ($rc.recall // $rc.rate // $rc.defect_catch_rate

You are a senior adversarial code reviewer for a repository of bash scripts, bats tests and docs (the "Loa" framework). A pull request is frozen under /workspace/pr: `pr/head.diff` is the full unified diff, `pr/base/<path>` holds each touched file before, `pr/head/<path>` after. Do NOT modify anything under /workspace/pr. Work in /tmp for any scratch.

Your slice is the "spend caps, ablation suite and arms, took-effect evidence, fingerprint/freeze/validate-suite" area. Review these files thoroughly (read the FULL head files; for modified files diff against base/):
- evals/harness/spend.sh (new) + evals/tests/spend.bats + evals/tests/fixtures/ablation/spend/{cost-ledger,rows,runs}.jsonl
- evals/harness/took-effect.sh (new) + evals/tests/took-effect.bats

- evals/harness/fingerprint.sh (modified), evals/harness/freeze.sh (modified) + evals/tests/freeze.bats
- evals/harness/validate-suite.sh (modified) + evals/tests/validate-suite.bats
- evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (new)
- evals/harness/execute-agent.sh hunks that concern arms/toggles (the arms[] vs ab.arms[] handling, `absent: true`), since run-arms.sh and arm-toggles.bats drive it.

Look for real defects the PR introduces: bash bugs (quoting, word splitting, set -e/pipefail pitfalls, `local x=$(cmd)` masking exit codes, unbound variables under set -u, arithmetic on floats, awk/jq numeric formatting of USD/micro-USD, integer overflow, locale), spend-cap logic errors (off-by-one at the cap, per-arm vs batch caps, missing rows counted as zero cost, double counting ledger + phase cost, the cap check reading the wrong file), wrong exit codes versus the header-comment contract, the yq/jq programs (precedence of `//` with `if`, null handling, field paths vs the fixture/suite yaml), suite yaml schema vs validate-suite.sh checks vs the ablation-2.0.yaml contents (do the arm names, toggle names, and version fields agree across suite yaml, run-arms.sh, execute-agent.sh and the tests?), took-effect evidence that can be trivially satisfied or that misses the case it claims to detect, and mismatches between the scripts and the tests/fixtures (option names, env vars, paths, output formats). Check that tests actually exercise the code (assertions that cannot fail, stubs that bypass the code under test, tests that would fail when run).

Run `bash -n` on each script and `shellcheck` if present (genuine issues only).

Output: a list of findings. For EACH finding give: `head/<path>:<line>` (line number in the pr/head/ file — verify with grep -n / sed -n), severity (critical|high|medium|low: damage if the scenario happens), confidence (high|medium|low: how sure you are it happens; high needs a concrete failing input), a one-sentence concrete failure scenario, and a short quote of the offending line. Also report which tests you ran and the summary, and anything you could not verify. Be precise and skeptical; skip pure style nits, but include every genuine defect however small. Do not invent findings — if an area is clean, say so.

A pull request is frozen under /workspace/pr: `pr/head.diff` is the full unified diff, `pr/base/<path>` holds each touched file before, `pr/head/<path>` after. Do NOT modify anything under /workspace/pr. Work in /tmp for any scratch.

Your slice is the "spend caps, ablation suite and arms, took-effect evidence, fingerprint/freeze/validate-suite" area. Review these files thoroughly (read the FULL head files; for modified files diff against base/):
- evals/harness/spend.sh (new) + evals/tests/spend.bats + evals/tests/fixtures/ablation/spend/{cost-ledger,rows,runs}.jsonl
- evals/harness/took-effect.sh (new) + evals/tests/took-effect.bats
- evals/harness/run-arms.sh (new) + evals/tests/run-arms.bats + evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats + evals/tests/fixtures/ablation/claude-ablation-stub.sh + evals/tests/fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash
- evals/harness/fingerprint.sh (modified), evals/harness/freeze.sh (modified) + evals/tests/freeze.bats
- evals/harness/validate-suite.sh (modified) + evals/tests/validate-suite.bats
- evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (new)
- evals/harness/execute-agent.sh hunks that concern arms/toggles (the arms[] vs ab.arms[] handling, `absent: true`), since run-arms.sh and arm-toggles.bats drive it.

Look for real defects the PR introduces: bash bugs (quoting, word splitting, set -e/pipefail pitfalls, `local x=$(cmd)` masking exit codes, unbound variables under set -u, arithmetic on floats, awk/jq numeric formatting of USD/micro-USD, integer overflow, locale), spend-cap logic errors (off-by-one at the cap, per-arm vs batch caps, missing rows counted as zero cost, double counting ledger + phase cost, the cap check reading the wrong file), wrong exit codes versus the header-comment contract, the yq/jq programs (precedence of `//` with `if`, null handling, field paths vs the fixture/suite yaml), suite yaml schema vs validate-suite.sh checks vs the ablation-2.0.yaml contents (do the arm names, toggle names, and version fields agree across suite yaml, run-arms.sh, execute-agent.sh and the tests?), took-effect evidence that can be trivially satisfied or that misses the case it claims to detect, and mismatches between the scripts and the tests/fixtures (option names, env vars, paths, output formats). Check that tests actually exercise the code (assertions that cannot fail, stubs that bypass the code under test, tests that would fail when run).

Where feasible, actually RUN the relevant bats tests against the head tree: copy pr/head to a scratch dir (cp -r /workspace/pr/head /tmp/head-spend), check `which bats jq yq`, run `bats evals/tests/spend.bats evals/tests/took-effect.bats evals/tests/run-arms.bats evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats evals/tests/freeze.bats evals/tests/validate-suite.bats` from the scratch copy and report pass/fail with failing test names and output (note which failures are only because the scratch copy lacks files from the real repo, e.g. .claude/ scripts). Run `bash -n` on each script and `shellcheck` if present (genuine issues only).

Output: a list of findings. For EACH finding give: `head/<path>:<line>` (line number in the pr/head/ file — verify with grep -n / sed -n), severity (critical|high|medium|low: damage if the scenario happens), confidence (high|medium|low: how sure you are it happens; high needs a concrete failing input), a one-sentence concrete failure scenario, and a short quote of the offending line. Also report which tests you ran and the summary, and anything you could not verify. Be precise and skeptical; skip pure style nits, but include every genuine defect however small. Do not invent findings — if an area is clean, say so.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
     4	#
     5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
     6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
     7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
     8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
     9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
    10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
    11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
    12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
    13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
    14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
    15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
    16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
    17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
    18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
    19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
    20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
    21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
    22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
    23	#
    24	# Usage:
    25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
    26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
    27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
    28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
    32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
    33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
    34	#                       alias --workspace
    35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
    36	#   --trial N           trial number
    37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
    38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
    39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
    40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
    41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
    44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
    45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
    46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
    47	#
    48	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
    49	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
    50	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
    51	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
    52	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
    53	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
    54	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
    55	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
    56	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
    57	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
    58	#
    59	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
    60	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
    61	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
    62	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
    63	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
    64	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
    65	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
    66	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
    67	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    68	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
    69	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
    70	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
    71	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    72	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
    73	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
    74	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
    75	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
    76	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
    77	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
    78	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
    79	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
    80	# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
    81	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
    82	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
    83	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
    84	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
    85	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
    86	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
    87	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
    88	#
    89	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
    90	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
    91	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
    92	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
    93	# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
    94	# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
    95	#
    96	# Exit codes:
    97	#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
    98	#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
    99	#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
   100	#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
   101	#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
   102	#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
   103	#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
   104	# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
   105	# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
   106	# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
   107	#
   108	# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
   109	# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
   110	# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR.
   111	#
   112	# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
   113	# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.
   114	#
   115	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary
   116	# copy of this harness whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is the stub mount library).
   117	# =============================================================================
   118	set -euo pipefail
   119	export LC_ALL=C
   120	shopt -u patsub_replacement 2>/dev/null || true   # bash 5.2: '&' in ${x//p/r} stays literal
   121	
   122	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
   123	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
   124	PROMPTS_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts"
   125	# No .claude/ code is sourced (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary": the
   126	# harness is the trusted copy and runs against a PR's .claude/).
   127	
   128	TASK_YAML="" ARM="" RUN_DIR="" RUN_ID="" TRIAL="" SOURCE_TREE="" SUITE_FILE=""
   129	MAX_RUN_USD="" EXECUTOR="${LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR:-container}" IMAGE="loa-ablation:258"
   130	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" DOCKER_BIN="${EVAL_DOCKER_BIN:-docker}"
   131	PHASE_MODELS_JSON="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS:-}" PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON="" DRY_RUN=false
   132	SPRINT="sprint-1"
   133	TOOLS_DEFAULT="Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"
   134	
   135	die_usage() { echo "pipeline-run.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
   136	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   137	  case "$1" in
   138	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   139	    --arm)            ARM="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   140	    --run-dir|--workspace) RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   141	    --run-id)         RUN_ID="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   142	    --trial)          TRIAL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   143	    --source-tree)    SOURCE_TREE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   144	    --suite-file)     SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   145	    --max-run-usd)    MAX_RUN_USD="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   146	    --executor)       EXECUTOR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   147	    --image)          IMAGE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   148	    --claude-bin)     CLAUDE_BIN="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   149	    --docker-bin)     DOCKER_BIN="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   150	    --phase-models)   PHASE_MODELS_JSON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   151	    --phase-timeouts) PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   152	    --dry-run)        DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
   153	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,105p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
   154	    *) die_usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
   155	  esac
   156	done
   157	
   158	for v in TASK_YAML ARM RUN_ID TRIAL SOURCE_TREE SUITE_FILE; do
   159	  [[ -n "${!v}" ]] || die_usage "missing --$(echo "$v" | tr 'A-Z_' 'a-z-')"
   160	done
   161	[[ "$DRY_RUN" == true || -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || die_usage "missing --run-dir"
   162	[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || die_usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
   163	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die_usage "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
   164	[[ -d "$SOURCE_TREE" ]] || die_usage "source tree not found: $SOURCE_TREE"
   165	[[ "$TRIAL" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die_usage "--trial must be an integer"
   166	case "$EXECUTOR" in container|host) ;; *) die_usage "--executor must be container or host" ;; esac
   167	for t in jq yq git timeout; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die_usage "required tool missing: $t"; done
   168	[[ -z "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-models must be a JSON object"
   169	[[ -z "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-timeouts must be a JSON object"
   170	[[ -n "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_MODELS_JSON='{}'
   171	[[ -n "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON='{}'
   172	
   173	TASK_YAML="$(cd "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")" && pwd)/$(basename "$TASK_YAML")"
   174	TASK_DIR="$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")"
   175	SUITE_ROOT="$(cd "$TASK_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
   176	SOURCE_TREE="$(cd "$SOURCE_TREE" && pwd)"
   177	
   178	TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || die_usage "task yaml does not parse: $TASK_YAML"
   179	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || die_usage "suite file does not parse: $SUITE_FILE"
   180	
   181	if [[ -z "$MAX_RUN_USD" ]]; then
   182	  MAX_RUN_USD="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // 12' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   183	  cfg_cap="$(yq -r '.evals.ablation.run_cap_usd // ""' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true)"
   184	  [[ -n "$cfg_cap" && "$cfg_cap" != "null" ]] && MAX_RUN_USD="$cfg_cap"
   185	fi
   186	[[ "$MAX_RUN_USD" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || die_usage "--max-run-usd must be a number"
   187	CAP_MICRO="$(jq -n --arg c "$MAX_RUN_USD" '($c|tonumber) * 1000000 | round')"
   188	
   189	TASK_ID="$(jq -r '.id // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
   190	TASK_TYPE="$(jq -r '.type // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
   191	[[ -n "$TASK_ID" ]] || die_usage "task has no id"
   192	case "$TASK_TYPE" in
   193	  review-catch) KIND="review-catch" ;;
   194	  bug-fix|refactor|feature-build) KIND="build" ;;
   195	  *) die_usage "task type '$TASK_TYPE' is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" ;;
   196	esac
   197	
   198	# --- arm and phase plan -------------------------------------------------------
   199	ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   200	ALL_ARM_IDS="$(jq -r '[.arms // [] | .[] | .id] | .[]' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   201	REFUSAL=""
   202	if [[ -z "$ARM_DEF" ]]; then
   203	  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
   204	elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
   205	  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
   206	elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \
   207	       '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   208	       >/dev/null <<<"$ARM_DEF"; then
   209	  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' does not apply to task type '$TASK_TYPE' (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   210	fi
   211	[[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || ARM_DEF='{}'
   212	SUITE_TOGGLES="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   213	
   214	# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
   215	plan_phases() {
   216	  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
   217	    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
   218	    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
   219	    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
   220	    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
   221	    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
   222	          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
   223	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   224	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]
   225	        else .out += [{name: $n, label: $n}] end)
   226	    | .out'
   227	}
   228	
   229	phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)
   230	  case "$1" in
   231	    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
   232	    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;
   233	  esac

     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)

     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,

    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#

    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.

You are a senior adversarial code reviewer for a repository of bash scripts, bats tests and docs (the "Loa" framework). A pull request is frozen under /workspace/pr: `pr/head.diff` is the full unified diff, `pr/base/<path>` holds each touched file before, `pr/head/<path>` after. Do NOT modify anything under /workspace/pr. Work in /tmp for any scratch.

Your slice is the "rows" area: evals/harness/ablation-row.sh (new, ~340 lines, mostly one big jq program) + evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (new) + the fixture tree evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/** (MANIFEST.json, suite.yaml, regen.sh, prs/pr-x/**, tasks/**). Also check the regen.sh fixture generator: does the fixture it claims to generate match what is checked in (MANIFEST.json arm_map vs run ids, suite.yaml)? Are fixture run dirs (meta/pipeline.json etc.) actually present under the fixture tree or does the bats test build them in setup — and if built in setup, do they match pipeline-run.sh's real output shape or only the row script's expectations (a test that only round-trips the author's own assumptions is a finding)?

Look for real defects: jq precedence errors (`//` with `if`, `|` vs `//`, `as` bindings), null handling (`.a.b` on non-objects errors in jq: e.g. `$g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate.review` when `$g` is a string, `e.metadata.companion_voice.planned` when metadata is a string), `fromdateiso8601` on timestamps with fractional seconds or offsets (what format does pipeline-run.sh write?), `--argjson` with empty strings, `index()` semantics on arrays, the --validate program's ability to actually reject bad rows (try feeding it rows with wrong types and see), the `[ need(...) ... ][0] // (...)` chain (does a `null`-valued legitimate first element short-circuit wrongly?), the status derivation vs the documented seven statuses, arm precedence (manifest > meta/arm > pipeline.json) vs the header comment, the flock usage, `set -euo pipefail` with `jq -e` in conditions, bash arithmetic, and whether every documented option exists. Check the bats tests actually exercise the code (assertions that cannot fail, fixtures that bypass the code under test, tests that would fail when run).

Where feasible, actually RUN: copy pr/head to a scratch dir (cp -r /workspace/pr/head /tmp/head-row), check `which bats jq yq`, run `bats evals/tests/ablation-row.bats` from the scratch copy and report pass/fail with failing test names and output (note failures only due to missing real-repo files). Also hand-craft a couple of rows to probe --validate (e.g. a row where status is "running", a row where phases[0].exit is a string, a row with degraded true and degraded_reason null) and report whether it rejects them. Run `bash -n` and `shellcheck` if present (genuine issues only).

Output: a list of findings. For EACH finding give: `head/<path>:<line>` (line number in the pr/head/ file — verify with grep -n / sed -n), severity (critical|high|medium|low: damage if the scenario happens), confidence (high|medium|low: how sure; high needs a concrete failing input), a one-sentence concrete failure scenario, and a short quote of the offending line. Also report which tests you ran and the summary, and anything you could not verify. Be precise and skeptical; skip pure style nits, but include every genuine defect however small. Do not invent findings — if an area is clean, say so.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/gen-checksums.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.1, DEC-0368)
     4	#
     5	# Writes the System Zone integrity manifest `.claude/checksums.json` from the
     6	# TRACKED `.claude/` tree only. The legacy generators (mount-loa.sh and
     7	# update.sh `generate_checksums`) walk the working tree with `find`, so build,
     8	# cache and runtime artefacts (`__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `node_modules`,
     9	# `.run/`) that exist only on the generating machine end up in the manifest and
    10	# read as Missing on every fresh mount. This generator lists
    11	#
    12	#   git -C ROOT ls-files -z -- .claude
    13	#
    14	# minus every path under `.claude/overrides/` (user-owned) and minus the
    15	# manifest itself (`.claude/checksums.json`), hashes each with
    16	# `sha256_portable` (.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh) and writes
    17	#
    18	#   {"generated": "<UTC ISO-8601>", "algorithm": "sha256",
    19	#    "files": {"<path>": "<sha256 hex>", ...}}
    20	#
    21	# pretty-printed by jq (2-space), keys in `LC_ALL=C` byte order. Two runs on
    22	# the same tree are byte-identical except `generated`. The working-tree content
    23	# of each tracked path is hashed (an unstaged edit is reflected); a tracked
    24	# path deleted from the working tree is skipped with a warning on stderr.
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/gen-checksums.sh [--root DIR] [--out FILE]   # (re)generate
    28	#   tools/gen-checksums.sh --check [--root DIR] [--out FILE]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --root DIR   repository work tree to read (default: the git top level of
    32	#                the current directory)
    33	#   --out FILE   manifest path (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json). With
    34	#                --check this is the committed manifest that is compared.
    35	#   --check      regenerate to a temp file and compare its `files` map with
    36	#                the manifest at --out; nothing is written
    37	#   -h, --help   this text
    38	#
    39	# Exit codes:
    40	#   0  generated, or --check: the `files` maps are identical
    41	#   1  --check: drift (the first ten differing paths, each labelled added /
    42	#      removed / changed, on stderr) or the manifest is absent / not JSON
    43	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or a tracked path name that
    44	#      cannot be represented safely (newline, tab or backslash)
    45	# =============================================================================
    46	set -euo pipefail
    47	export LC_ALL=C
    48	
    49	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    50	# shellcheck source=../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh
    51	source "${SELF_DIR}/../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    52	
    53	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    54	die2() { echo "gen-checksums: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    55	
    56	MANIFEST_REL=".claude/checksums.json"
    57	ROOT=""
    58	OUT=""
    59	CHECK=0
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --check) CHECK=1; shift ;;
    63	    --root)
    64	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    65	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --out)
    67	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--out requires a file path"
    68	      OUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    69	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    70	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    71	  esac
    72	done
    73	
    74	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    75	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
    76	fi
    77	[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
    78	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
    79	[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
    80	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
    81	[[ -n "$OUT" ]] || OUT="${ROOT}/${MANIFEST_REL}"
    82	
    83	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gen-checksums.XXXXXX")"

    87	# --- 1. the tracked set (NUL-safe, C-sorted, overrides and manifest removed) --
    88	files=()
    89	while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
    90	  case "$path" in
    91	    .claude/overrides/*|"$MANIFEST_REL") continue ;;

    93	  case "$path" in
    94	    *$'\n'*|*$'\t'*|*\\*) die2 "refusing a tracked path with a newline, tab or backslash: $(printf '%q' "$path")" ;;

   103	
   104	# --- 2. hash in chunks (one sha256 process per 400 paths, order preserved) ----
   105	TSV="${TMP_DIR}/files.tsv"

   107	n=${#files[@]}
   108	i=0
   109	while [[ $i -lt $n ]]; do
   110	  chunk=("${files[@]:i:400}")

   112	  while IFS= read -r line; do

   117	  while [[ $j -lt ${#chunk[@]} ]]; do
   118	    [[ "${hashes[j]}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die2 "unexpected sha256 output for ${chunk[j]}"
   119	    printf '%s\t%s\n' "${chunk[j]}" "${hashes[j]}" >> "$TSV"
   120	    j=$((j + 1))
   121	  done
   122	  i=$((i + 400))
   123	done
   124	[[ $n -gt 0 ]] || echo "gen-checksums: warning: no tracked files under .claude in $ROOT" >&2
   125	
   126	GEN="${TMP_DIR}/checksums.json"
   127	jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
   128	  {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
   129	   files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | split("\t") | {key: .[0], value: .[1]}] | from_entries)}
   130	' < "$TSV" > "$GEN"
   131	
   132	# --- 3a. write ----------------------------------------------------------------
   133	if [[ $CHECK -eq 0 ]]; then
   134	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
   135	  chmod 0644 "$GEN"
   136	  # mv replaces a symlinked manifest instead of writing through it.
   137	  mv -f "$GEN" "$OUT"
   138	  echo "gen-checksums: wrote $n entries to $OUT" >&2
   139	  exit 0
   140	fi
   141	
   142	# --- 3b. --check --------------------------------------------------------------
   143	if [[ ! -f "$OUT" ]]; then
   144	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: manifest not found: $OUT (run tools/gen-checksums.sh)" >&2
   145	  exit 1
   146	fi
   147	if ! jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$OUT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   148	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: manifest is not JSON with a files object: $OUT" >&2
   149	  exit 1
