   151	DIFF="${TMP_DIR}/diff.txt"
   152	jq -rn --slurpfile old "$OUT" --slurpfile new "$GEN" '
   153	  ($old[0].files) as $o | ($new[0].files) as $n |
   154	  ( [ $n | keys[] | . as $p | select($o | has($p) | not) | {p: $p, k: "added"} ]
   155	  + [ $o | keys[] | . as $p | select($n | has($p) | not) | {p: $p, k: "removed"} ]
   156	  + [ $n | keys[] | . as $p | select(($o | has($p)) and $o[$p] != $n[$p]) | {p: $p, k: "changed"} ] )
   157	  | sort_by(.p) | .[] | "\(.k): \(.p)"
   158	' > "$DIFF"

   160	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
   161	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: OK ($n entries match $OUT)" >&2
   162	  exit 0
   163	fi
   164	echo "gen-checksums: --check: DRIFT — $count path(s) differ between $OUT and the tracked tree:" >&2
   165	sed -n '1,10s/^/  /p' "$DIFF" >&2
   166	[[ "$count" -le 10 ]] || echo "  ... and $((count - 10)) more" >&2

   168	exit 1

    11	# boundary), so there is no environment override to point. The executor runs the CLI under
    12	# `env -i`, which strips the stubs' control variables, so each test reaches the
    13	# stubs through generated wrappers ($T/claude, $T/docker) that first record the
    14	# environment and descriptors the executor gave them, then load $T/stub.env.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
     4	#
     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
     9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
    10	#
    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
    14	#
    15	# Derived fields:
    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
    20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
    23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
    25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
    26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
    27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
    29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
    31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
    32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
    33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
    34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
    35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
    36	#
    37	# Usage:
    38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
    39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
    40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
    41	#
    42	# Options:
    43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
    44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
    45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
    46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
    47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
    48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
    49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
    50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
    51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
    52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
    53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
    54	#                      bad row naming its line number
    55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
    56	#
    57	# Exit codes:
    58	#   0  row written / file valid
    59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
    60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
    61	#
    62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
    63	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    64	# =============================================================================
    65	set -euo pipefail
    66	export LC_ALL=C
    67	
    68	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
    69	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
    70	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    71	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    72	  case "$1" in
    73	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    82	    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
    83	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    84	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
    89	
    90	# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    91	if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
    92	  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
    93	  n=0 bad=0
    94	  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    95	    n=$((n + 1))
    96	    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
    97	    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
    98	      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
    99	      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
   100	                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
   101	                       else empty end;
   102	      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
   103	      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
   104	      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
   105	      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
   106	        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
   107	        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
   108	        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
   109	        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
   110	        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
   111	        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
   112	        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
   113	        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
   114	        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
   115	        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
   116	        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
   117	        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
   118	        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
   119	      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
   120	           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
   121	      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
   122	      // (if (.zone_violations.dot_claude_writes | type) != "array" then "zone_violations.dot_claude_writes is not an array" else empty end)
   123	      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
   124	      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
   125	           then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
   126	      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
   127	           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
   128	      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
   129	           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
   130	               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
   131	                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
   132	                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
   133	                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
   134	                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
   135	                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
   136	                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
   137	      // (if $ungraded then empty
   138	          elif (["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","contaminated"] | index($row.status)) == null then empty
   139	          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
   140	            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   141	          else
   142	            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
   143	               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   144	          end)
   145	      // empty
   146	      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
   147	    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
   148	      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
   149	      exit 1
   150	    fi
   151	  done < "$VALIDATE"
   152	  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"
   153	  exit 0
   154	fi
   155	
   156	# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------

+#   present, hash differs            -> Tampered (fail)
+#   absent, submodule mount detected (.loa/.claude is a directory) and the
+#     path exists under .loa/<path>   -> not-mounted (counted, one summary
+#     line, informational: never changes the exit code; the mount links a
+#     subset of the upstream tree by design)
+#   absent otherwise                 -> Missing (fail)
+# The manifest is read once (path<TAB>hash) instead of one jq call per path.
 check_integrity() {
   echo "Checking System Zone integrity (sha256)..."
   [[ -f "$CHECKSUMS_FILE" ]] || { warn "No checksums file - skipping integrity check"; return; }
 
   local drift=false
-  while IFS= read -r file; do
-    local expected=$(jq -r --arg f "$file" '.files[$f]' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
-    [[ -z "$expected" || "$expected" == "null" ]] && continue
+  local submodule_mount=false
+  local not_mounted=0
+  local file expected actual
+  [[ -d ".loa/.claude" ]] && submodule_mount=true
+
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r file expected; do
+    [[ -z "$file" || -z "$expected" || "$expected" == "null" ]] && continue
 
     if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
-      local actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
+      actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
       if [[ "$expected" != "$actual" ]]; then
         fail "Tampered: $file"
         drift=true
       fi
+    elif [[ "$submodule_mount" == "true" && -f ".loa/${file}" ]]; then
+      not_mounted=$((not_mounted + 1))
     else
       fail "Missing: $file"
       drift=true
     fi
-  done < <(jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
+  done < <(jq -r '.files | to_entries[] | "\(.key)\t\(.value)"' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
 
+  if [[ $not_mounted -gt 0 ]]; then
+    log "not-mounted: ${not_mounted} path(s) exist in the upstream tree but are not linked by this mount"
+  fi
   [[ "$drift" == "false" ]] && log "Integrity verified"
+  return 0
 }

   681	  [ "$(sed -n '/home\/evaluser/,$p' "$m" | sed 1d | tr '\n' ' ')" = "  .aws   .claude   .claude.json   .codex   .codex/auth.json   .codex/config.toml " ]

   684	
   685	@test "container: the per-run HOME persists across the phases of one run and is deleted when interrupted" {
   686	  printf 'STUB_SLEEP_IMPLEMENT=30\n' > "$T/stub.env"
   687	  "$PR" --task-yaml "$BUILD" --arm a1_full --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id r1 --trial 1 --source-tree "$T/src" \
   688	    --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor container --docker-bin "$T/docker" > "$T/out" 2>&1 &
   689	  local pid=$! n=0
   690	  while [ ! -e "$T/run/meta/phase-IMPLEMENT.argv.json" ] && [ $n -lt 100 ]; do sleep 0.1; n=$((n + 1)); done
   691	  sleep 0.5
   692	  [ -d "$T/run/meta/home/.codex" ]
   693	  [ "$(stat -c %a "$T/run/meta/home")" = 700 ]
   694	  # PLAN and IMPLEMENT mounted the same HOME
   695	  [ "$(grep -h 'home/evaluser' "$T/dlog/run-1.mounts" "$T/dlog/run-2.mounts" | sort -u | wc -l)" -eq 1 ]
   696	  kill -TERM "$pid"
   697	  local rc=0; wait "$pid" || rc=$?
   698	  [ "$rc" -eq 4 ]

   702	
   703	@test "bedrock route: the bearer token and route keys reach the CLI (host and container); no artefact carries the token" {
   704	  local tok="tok-SECRET-$RANDOM-bedrock"

   706	  export AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK="$tok" AWS_REGION=us-east-1 ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX=global \
   707	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL=global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL=global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5 \
   708	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5
   709	  local mode
   710	  for mode in host container; do
   711	    rm_run; rm -f "$T/log/token.check"
   712	    run "$PR" --task-yaml "$BUILD" --arm a1_full --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id r1 --trial 1 --source-tree "$T/src" \
   713	      --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor "$mode" --claude-bin "$T/claude" --docker-bin "$T/docker"
   714	    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$mode: $output"; return 1; }
   715	    # every phase got the token (the wrapper compares it with the expected value)
   716	    [ "$(sort -u "$T/log/token.check")" = match ] || { echo "$mode: token check"; return 1; }
   717	    [ "$(wc -l < "$T/log/token.check" | tr -d ' ')" -ge 4 ]   # four phases (+ the fingerprint's --version in host mode)
   718	    grep -qx 'AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK=<set>' "$T/log/call-1.env"
   719	    grep -qx 'ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX=global' "$T/log/call-1.env"
   720	    grep -qx 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL=global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5' "$T/log/call-1.env"
   721	    grep -qx 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5' "$T/log/call-1.env"
   722	    grep -qx 'AWS_REGION=us-east-1' "$T/log/call-1.env"
   723	    [ "$(jq -r '.env.AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK' "$T/run/meta/phase-PLAN.argv.json")" = '<set>' ]
   724	    # the value is nowhere under the run dir (captures, launcher argv, transcripts, logs)
   725	    ! grep -rqF "$tok" "$T/run" || { echo "$mode: token leaked"; grep -rlF "$tok" "$T/run"; return 1; }
   726	    ! grep -rqF "$tok" "$T/log" "$T/dlog"
   727	  done
   728	  # container: the token travels to docker by name only
   729	  grep -qx 'AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK' < <(tr '\0' '\n' < "$T/dlog/run-1.argv")
   730	}

   747	
   748	@test "fingerprint.sh: fp:<sha256> over the tool versions and the source tree HEAD" {

   757	  ( cd "$T/src" && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m two )

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/tests/ablation-row.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.8 (SDD §3.1, §5.8; AC-1.8, PRD AC-6.3)
     4	#
     5	# evals/harness/ablation-row.sh joins a run directory (meta/pipeline.json, eval/
     6	# MODELINV and cost ledgers, dissent envelopes, transcripts), grade.json and the
     7	# batch MANIFEST.json into one runs.jsonl row, and --validate checks rows. The run
     8	# directories are the fixtures under evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/runs/
     9	# (real pipeline-run.sh runs against the stub CLI; rebuilt by regen.sh); each test
    10	# works on a copy.
    11	# =============================================================================
    12	
    13	setup() {
    14	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    15	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    16	  ROW="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/ablation-row.sh"
    17	  FX="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-runs"
    18	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
    19	  cp -a "$FX/runs" "$T/runs"
    20	  cp "$FX/MANIFEST.json" "$T/MANIFEST.json"
    21	  BUILD_TASK="$FX/tasks/bf-01/task.yaml" REVIEW_TASK="$FX/tasks/rc-01/task.yaml"
    22	}
    23	
    24	teardown() {
    25	  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    26	  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
    27	}
    28	
    29	row() {  # row <run> <task-yaml> [extra args…] → $T/rows.jsonl (appended)
    30	  local run="$1" task="$2"; shift 2
    31	  "$ROW" --run-dir "$T/runs/$run" --task-yaml "$task" --manifest "$T/MANIFEST.json" --out "$T/rows.jsonl" "$@"
    32	}
    33	last() { sed -n '$p' "$T/rows.jsonl"; }
    34	edit_pipe() {  # edit_pipe <run> <jq filter>
    35	  jq "$2" "$T/runs/$1/meta/pipeline.json" > "$T/p.json" && mv "$T/p.json" "$T/runs/$1/meta/pipeline.json"
    36	}
    37	
    38	@test "a full graded A1 build row validates and carries the joined fields" {
    39	  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
    40	  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/rows.jsonl"
    41	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    42	  local r; r="$(last)"
    43	  [ "$(jq -r '.arm + " " + .batch + " " + .task_type' <<<"$r")" = "a1_full fixture-batch bug-fix" ]
    44	  [ "$(jq -r '.hidden_test_pass_rate' <<<"$r")" = 0.875 ]
    45	  [ "$(jq -r '.verdict' <<<"$r")" = APPROVED ]
    46	  # a false accuracy stays false (never null)
    47	  [ "$(jq -r '"\(.verdict_accuracy) \(.verdict_accuracy_review) \(.verdict_accuracy_audit)"' <<<"$r")" = "false true false" ]
    48	  [ "$(jq -r '.image_digest + " " + .host_fingerprint' <<<"$r")" = "sha256:fixture-image fp:fixture" ]
    49	  [ "$(jq -r '[.phases[].label] | join(",")' <<<"$r")" = "PLAN,IMPLEMENT,REVIEW,FIX1,AUDIT" ]
    50	  [[ "$(jq -r '.snapshots.implement' <<<"$r")" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
    51	  [[ "$(jq -r '.snapshots.fix1' <<<"$r")" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
    52	  [ "$(jq -r '.snapshots.fix2' <<<"$r")" = null ]
    53	  [ "$(jq -r '.suite_version' <<<"$r")" = 1 ]
    54	  [ "$(jq -r '.status + " " + (.degraded | tostring)' <<<"$r")" = "completed false" ]
    55	}
    56	
    57	@test "effort_effective per phase comes from the sandbox MODELINV rows the phase wrote" {
    58	  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
    59	  local r; r="$(last)"
    60	  [ "$(jq -r '[.phases[] | "\(.label)=\(.effort_effective)"] | join(" ")' <<<"$r")" = "PLAN=null IMPLEMENT=null REVIEW=xhigh FIX1=null AUDIT=xhigh" ]
    61	  [ "$(jq -r '[.phases[] | select(.label == "REVIEW")][0].voice_cost_usd' <<<"$r")" = 0.4 ]
    62	  # cost = Σ result cost (5 phases × 0.5) + Σ ledger (0.4 + 0.3)
    63	  [ "$(jq -r '.cost_usd' <<<"$r")" = 3.2 ]
    64	}
    65	
    66	@test "voices_run comes from the dissent envelopes; null for A0 and A4" {
    67	  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
    68	  [ "$(jq -c '.voices_run.review | {planned, completed, quality}' <<<"$(last)")" = '{"planned":2,"completed":2,"quality":"APPROVED"}' ]
    69	  row a3-review "$REVIEW_TASK"
    70	  [ "$(jq -r '"\(.voices_run.review.planned) \(.voices_run.audit.companion_planned)"' <<<"$(last)")" = "1 false" ]
    71	  row a0-build "$BUILD_TASK"
    72	  [ "$(jq -r '.voices_run' <<<"$(last)")" = null ]
    73	  row a4-build "$BUILD_TASK"
    74	  [ "$(jq -r '.voices_run' <<<"$(last)")" = null ]
    75	}
    76	
    77	@test "review-catch rows fill the defect fields and leave hidden_tests null" {
    78	  row a3-review "$REVIEW_TASK"
    79	  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/rows.jsonl"
    80	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    81	  local r; r="$(last)"
    82	  [ "$(jq -r '"\(.defects_seeded) \(.defects_caught) \(.defect_catch_rate) \(.flags) \(.false_positives) \(.hidden_tests)"' <<<"$r")" = "3 2 0.6667 4 1 null" ]
    83	}
    84	
    85	@test "--validate rejects a row missing any §3.1 field (each field in turn)" {
    86	  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
    87	  local good f fields
    88	  good="$(last)"
    89	  fields="schema_version run_id batch arm task_id task_type trial source_commit suite_manifest_sha256 suite_version host_fingerprint image_digest agy_opt_in started finished phases voices_run hidden_tests hidden_test_pass_rate defects_seeded defects_caught defect_catch_rate flags false_positives verdict verdict_accuracy verdict_accuracy_review verdict_accuracy_audit regressions diff_lines files_changed cost_usd wall_clock_ms tokens_in tokens_out stalls attempts retry_reason degraded degraded_reason status snapshots contaminated zone_violations"
    90	  for f in $fields; do
    91	    jq -c --arg f "$f" 'del(.[$f])' <<<"$good" > "$T/one.jsonl"
    92	    run "$ROW" --validate "$T/one.jsonl" --allow-ungraded
    93	    [ "$status" -eq 1 ] || { echo "field $f: status $status"; return 1; }
    94	    [[ "$output" == *"missing field $f"* ]] || { echo "field $f: $output"; return 1; }
    95	  done
    96	  for f in name session_id model_requested models_used effort_requested effort_effective tokens_in tokens_out cache_read_tokens cache_creation_tokens cost_usd duration_ms num_turns exit refusal_fallbacks; do
    97	    jq -c --arg f "$f" '.phases[0] |= del(.[$f])' <<<"$good" > "$T/one.jsonl"
    98	    run "$ROW" --validate "$T/one.jsonl" --allow-ungraded
    99	    [ "$status" -eq 1 ] && [[ "$output" == *"phases[0]: missing field $f"* ]] || { echo "phase field $f: $output"; return 1; }
   100	  done
   101	}
   102	
   103	@test "--validate rejects wrong types and bad enums and names the line number" {
   104	  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
   105	  local good; good="$(last)"
   106	  { echo "$good"; jq -c '.cost_usd = "3.2"' <<<"$good"; } > "$T/two.jsonl"
   107	  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/two.jsonl"
   108	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   109	  [[ "$output" == *"two.jsonl:2: field cost_usd has type string"* ]]
   110	  jq -c '.status = "done"' <<<"$good" > "$T/one.jsonl"
   111	  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/one.jsonl"
   112	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ] && [[ "$output" == *"status done is not one of"* ]]
   113	  jq -c '.task_type = "build"' <<<"$good" > "$T/one.jsonl"
   114	  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/one.jsonl"
   115	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ] && [[ "$output" == *"task_type build"* ]]
   116	  jq -c '.degraded = true' <<<"$good" > "$T/one.jsonl"
   117	  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/one.jsonl"
   118	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ] && [[ "$output" == *"degraded without degraded_reason"* ]]
   119	  echo 'not json' > "$T/one.jsonl"
   120	  run "$ROW" --validate "$T/one.jsonl"
   121	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
   122	}
   123	
   124	@test "--validate accepts each of the seven status values" {
   125	  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
   126	  local good s; good="$(last)"
   127	  : > "$T/seven.jsonl"
   128	  for s in completed cap_failure agent_error transport_error infrastructure_error interrupted contaminated; do
   129	    jq -c --arg s "$s" '.status = $s' <<<"$good" >> "$T/seven.jsonl"

   136	@test "an ungraded smoke row has null grade fields; --validate needs --allow-ungraded for it" {

   142	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   143	}
   144	
   145	@test "degraded: a model other than the requested one in models_used" {
   146	  edit_pipe a1-build '(.phases[] | select(.label == "IMPLEMENT") | .models_used) = {"global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5": 10, "claude-sonnet-5": 90}'
   147	  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"
   148	  [ "$(jq -r '.degraded' <<<"$(last)")" = true ]
   149	  [[ "$(jq -r '.degraded_reason' <<<"$(last)")" == *"IMPLEMENT: model claude-sonnet-5 used, global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 requested"* ]]

   160	  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"

   167	  row a1-build "$BUILD_TASK"

   172	
   173	@test "degraded: a DEGRADED envelope, and an envelope with fewer completed voices than planned" {

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# regen.sh — rebuild the fixture run directories under runs/ (cycle-130 Sprint 258)
     3	#
     4	# Each fixture is a real evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh run (host executor) against
     5	# the stub CLI (../claude-stub-pipeline.sh) and the stub mount library
     6	# (../mount-lib-stub.sh), using suite.yaml and the tasks under tasks/. The sandbox's
     7	# own .git and the snapshot bundles are dropped (no nested repositories in the
     8	# tracked tree); absolute paths are rewritten to /fixture and /home/operator.
     9	# grade.json files and MANIFEST.json are written here as Sprint 259's grader and
    10	# run-ablation.sh would shape them (SDD §3.4, §3.6).

    56	mkdir -p "$OUT"

# Copy of evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml as implementer B landed it (Sprint 258); the fixture runs and
# evals/tests/{pipeline-run,ablation-row,took-effect}.bats read this copy so the tests do not move with the live suite.
# =============================================================================
# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
#
# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
#
# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
# task_types against the known types).
#
# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
# =============================================================================
name: ablation-2.0
version: 1
source_commit: "<sprint-258-commit>"   # the lead sets the Sprint 258 commit (rc.5 plus the mount fix; F2, DEC-0392)
agy_opt_in: false
tasks:
  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
suite_version: 1
trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250}   # reserve released to A7 when the re-verification rule needs no run (DEC-0398)
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 40, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 40, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 20, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 20, BARE: 70}
  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

arms:
  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a8_no_ceremonies, label: A8, absent: true,
     evidence: "no /meeting command, skill or sosyete config key at 4d69c3c4 (grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/; ls .claude/commands .claude/skills)"}

rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
  threshold_points: 0.03
  cost_lower_pct: 15
  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)
  predicates:                                # DEC-0416; d = arm − A1 point estimate, [lo, hi] its 90 % interval, c/w = cost/wall-clock Δ %
    investigate: "any applicable primary has lo > 0"
    keep: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03 and hi < 0"
    inconclusive: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03, or the arm's excluded share > 0.25, or no valid pair"
    remove: "else every applicable primary has d >= -0.03 and (c <= -15 or w <= -15)"
    simplify: "else (every applicable primary within -0.03, cost similar)"
  review_catch: {defect_counts_once_across_gates: true, false_positive_dedupe: cited_region, verdict_accurate_iff: "CHANGES_REQUIRED when the key holds a high or critical defect, APPROVED when none"}   # DEC-0420
  inconclusive_extension_trials: 2
  h1: "a1_full beats a0_bare on at least one primary with the interval excluding zero, else halt before promotion"
  a4_sensitivity: "a4_no_gates worse than a1_full on hidden_test_pass_rate with the interval excluding zero, else harden tasks before acting on other arms"
  decision_states: [investigate, keep, inconclusive, remove, simplify, not_run_cut, inconclusive_by_power]
  mde_cut: 0.10   # sprint Task 3.4: an arm whose MDE at affordable trials exceeds this is pre-declared inconclusive_by_power and not run

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    68	  case "$1" in
    69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    76	  esac
    77	done
    78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
    79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
    80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
    81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
    82	
    83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
    84	EVID=""
    85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }

    90	}
    91	
    92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
    93	  local type kind

    98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   105	    | .out | join(",")'
   106	}
   107	
   108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi

   111	}
   112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   113	  local f n=0 hit=""
   114	  while IFS= read -r f; do

   116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   117	  done < <(argv_files)
   118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
#
# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
#
# Usage:
#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
#
# Options:
#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
#                       alias --workspace
#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
#   --trial N           trial number
#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
#
# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
#
# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
#
# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
#
# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR.
#
# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.
#
# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary
# copy of this harness whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is the stub mount library).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
shopt -u patsub_replacement 2>/dev/null || true   # bash 5.2: '&' in ${x//p/r} stays literal

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
PROMPTS_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts"
# No .claude/ code is sourced (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary": the
# harness is the trusted copy and runs against a PR's .claude/).

TASK_YAML="" ARM="" RUN_DIR="" RUN_ID="" TRIAL="" SOURCE_TREE="" SUITE_FILE=""
MAX_RUN_USD="" EXECUTOR="${LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR:-container}" IMAGE="loa-ablation:258"
CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" DOCKER_BIN="${EVAL_DOCKER_BIN:-docker}"
PHASE_MODELS_JSON="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS:-}" PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON="" DRY_RUN=false
SPRINT="sprint-1"
TOOLS_DEFAULT="Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"

die_usage() { echo "pipeline-run.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --arm)            ARM="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-dir|--workspace) RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/check-manifest-paths.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.2, DEC-0368)
     4	#
     5	# CI gate for the System Zone integrity manifest: every path listed in
     6	# `.claude/checksums.json` must be TRACKED (`git ls-files -- .claude`) and
     7	# PRESENT in the working tree. A manifest generated by walking a dirty tree
     8	# (the #1267 class) lists build, cache and runtime artefacts that no fresh
     9	# mount has, so every downstream `check-loa.sh` reports them as Missing.
    10	#
    11	# Offenders are grouped on stderr:
    12	#   untracked  — listed in the manifest, not in `git ls-files`; each carries a
    13	#                DIAGNOSTIC class (first match wins):
    14	#                  __pycache__ | .pytest_cache | node_modules | .run
    15	#                      (a path component of that name)
    16	#                  .pyc   (name ends in .pyc)
    17	#                  .lock  (name ends in .lock)
    18	#                  other
    19	#   missing    — tracked, but absent from the working tree
    20	# The classes label untracked offenders only: a TRACKED path is never flagged
    21	# for its name (a committed `.lock` fixture is legitimate).
    22	#
    23	# Last line on stdout:
    24	#   manifest-paths: N entries, M untracked (class=count, ...), K missing
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/check-manifest-paths.sh [--manifest FILE] [--root DIR]
    28	#
    29	# Options:
    30	#   --root DIR       repository work tree (default: the git top level of the
    31	#                    current directory)
    32	#   --manifest FILE  manifest to check (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json)
    33	#   -h, --help       this text
    34	#
    35	# Exit codes:
    36	#   0  every manifest path is tracked and present
    37	#   1  at least one untracked or missing path (listed on stderr)
    38	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or the manifest is absent or
    39	#      not JSON with a `files` object
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die2() { echo "check-manifest-paths: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    46	
    47	ROOT=""
    48	MANIFEST=""
    49	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    50	  case "$1" in
    51	    --root)
    52	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    53	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    54	    --manifest)
    55	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--manifest requires a file path"
    56	      MANIFEST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    58	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    59	  esac
    60	done
    61	
    62	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    63	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
    64	fi
    65	[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
    66	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
    67	[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
    68	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
    69	[[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]] || MANIFEST="${ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json"
    70	[[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || die2 "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
    71	jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$MANIFEST" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    72	  || die2 "manifest is not JSON with a files object: $MANIFEST"
    73	
    74	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/check-manifest-paths.XXXXXX")"
    75	cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
    76	trap cleanup EXIT
    77	
    78	# Both lists newline-separated and C-sorted. A path with a newline cannot be
    79	# represented in either list; gen-checksums.sh refuses to emit one.
    80	git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -- .claude | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/tracked"
    81	jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$MANIFEST" | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/listed"
    82	comm -23 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
    83	comm -12 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/both"
    84	
    85	classify() {
    86	  local p="$1"
    87	  if [[ "$p" =~ (^|/)(__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|node_modules|\.run)(/|$) ]]; then
    88	    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    89	  elif [[ "$p" == *.pyc ]]; then
    90	    printf '.pyc'
    91	  elif [[ "$p" == *.lock ]]; then
    92	    printf '.lock'
    93	  else
    94	    printf 'other'
    95	  fi
    96	}
    97	
    98	# Classified untracked offenders: "<class>\t<path>"
    99	: > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   100	while IFS= read -r p; do
   101	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   102	  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(classify "$p")" "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   103	done < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
   104	
   105	: > "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   106	while IFS= read -r p; do
   107	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   108	  [[ -e "${ROOT}/${p}" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   109	done < "${TMP_DIR}/both"
   110	
   111	entries=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/listed" | tr -d ' ')
   112	n_untracked=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | tr -d ' ')
   113	n_missing=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/missing" | tr -d ' ')
   114	
   115	class_summary=""
   116	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 ]]; then
   117	  echo "check-manifest-paths: untracked manifest paths (not in git ls-files -- .claude), by class:" >&2
   118	  for cls in __pycache__ .pytest_cache node_modules .run .pyc .lock other; do
   119	    c=$(awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
   120	    [[ "$c" -gt 0 ]] || continue
   121	    class_summary="${class_summary:+${class_summary}, }${cls}=${c}"
   122	    echo "  [${cls}] ${c} path(s):" >&2
   123	    awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c { print "    " $2 }' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" >&2
   124	  done
   125	fi
   126	if [[ "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   127	  echo "check-manifest-paths: tracked manifest paths absent from the working tree:" >&2
   128	  sed 's/^/    /' "${TMP_DIR}/missing" >&2
   129	fi
   130	
   131	echo "manifest-paths: ${entries} entries, ${n_untracked} untracked${class_summary:+ (${class_summary})}, ${n_missing} missing"
   132	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 || "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   133	  echo "check-manifest-paths: FAIL — regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   134	  exit 1
   135	fi
   136	exit 0

done

for v in TASK_YAML ARM RUN_ID TRIAL SOURCE_TREE SUITE_FILE; do
  [[ -n "${!v}" ]] || die_usage "missing --$(echo "$v" | tr 'A-Z_' 'a-z-')"

[[ "$TRIAL" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die_usage "--trial must be an integer"
case "$EXECUTOR" in container|host) ;; *) die_usage "--executor must be container or host" ;; esac
for t in jq yq git timeout; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die_usage "required tool missing: $t"; done
[[ -z "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-models must be a JSON object"
[[ -z "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-timeouts must be a JSON object"
[[ -n "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_MODELS_JSON='{}'
[[ -n "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON='{}'

TASK_YAML="$(cd "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")" && pwd)/$(basename "$TASK_YAML")"
TASK_DIR="$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")"
SUITE_ROOT="$(cd "$TASK_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
SOURCE_TREE="$(cd "$SOURCE_TREE" && pwd)"

TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || die_usage "task yaml does not parse: $TASK_YAML"
SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || die_usage "suite file does not parse: $SUITE_FILE"

if [[ -z "$MAX_RUN_USD" ]]; then
  MAX_RUN_USD="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // 12' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  cfg_cap="$(yq -r '.evals.ablation.run_cap_usd // ""' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$cfg_cap" && "$cfg_cap" != "null" ]] && MAX_RUN_USD="$cfg_cap"
fi
[[ "$MAX_RUN_USD" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || die_usage "--max-run-usd must be a number"
CAP_MICRO="$(jq -n --arg c "$MAX_RUN_USD" '($c|tonumber) * 1000000 | round')"

TASK_ID="$(jq -r '.id // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
TASK_TYPE="$(jq -r '.type // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
[[ -n "$TASK_ID" ]] || die_usage "task has no id"
case "$TASK_TYPE" in
  review-catch) KIND="review-catch" ;;
  bug-fix|refactor|feature-build) KIND="build" ;;
  *) die_usage "task type '$TASK_TYPE' is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" ;;
esac

# --- arm and phase plan -------------------------------------------------------
ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
ALL_ARM_IDS="$(jq -r '[.arms // [] | .[] | .id] | .[]' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
REFUSAL=""
if [[ -z "$ARM_DEF" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \
       '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
       >/dev/null <<<"$ARM_DEF"; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' does not apply to task type '$TASK_TYPE' (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"

[[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || ARM_DEF='{}'
SUITE_TOGGLES="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"

# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
plan_phases() {
  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]
        else .out += [{name: $n, label: $n}] end)
    | .out'
}

phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)
  case "$1" in
    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;

}
builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }

phase_model() {
  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
}
phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
  local n="$1" key="$2" v
  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
  fi
  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi

  printf '%s' "$v"

phase_timeout_s() {
  local o; o="$(jq -r --arg n "$1" '.[$n] // empty' <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON")"
  if [[ -n "$o" ]]; then printf '%s' "$o"; else printf '%s' $(( $(phase_cap "$1" timeout_min) * 60 )); fi

TOOLS="$(jq -r --arg d "$TOOLS_DEFAULT" '.phase_defaults.tools // $d | if type == "array" then join(",") else . end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
EFFORT_FLAG="$(jq -r '.effort // .toggles.effort // empty' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
case "$EFFORT_FLAG" in ""|low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) die_usage "arm effort '$EFFORT_FLAG' is not low|medium|high|xhigh|max" ;; esac

  single="$(jq -r '.context_resets == false' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"

    --argjson trial "$TRIAL" --arg source_commit "$SOURCE_COMMIT" --argjson suite_version "$SUITE_VERSION" \
    --argjson phases "$phases" --arg status "$STATUS" --arg cap_phase "$CAP_PHASE" --argjson cap_turn "$CAP_TURN" \
    --arg reason "$REASON" --argjson arm_evidence "$ev" --argjson toggles "$TOGGLES" --arg executor "$EXECUTOR" \
    --arg image_digest "$IMAGE_DIGEST" --arg fingerprint "$FINGERPRINT" --arg tools "$TOOLS" \
    --argjson snapshots "$SNAPSHOTS_JSON" --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" \
    --argjson spent "$SPENT_MICRO" --arg cap "$MAX_RUN_USD" --arg effort "$EFFORT_FLAG" '
    {schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, arm: $arm, task_id: $task_id, task_type: $task_type, trial: $trial,
     source_commit: $source_commit, suite_version: $suite_version, status: $status,
     cap_phase: (if $cap_phase == "" then null else $cap_phase end), cap_turn: $cap_turn,
     reason: (if $reason == "" then null else $reason end),
     max_run_usd: ($cap | tonumber), spent_usd: ($spent / 1000000),
     arm_toggles: $toggles, effort_flag: (if $effort == "" then null else $effort end), arm_evidence: $arm_evidence,
     executor_mode: $executor, image_digest: (if $image_digest == "" then null else $image_digest end),
     fingerprint: (if $fingerprint == "" then null else $fingerprint end), sandbox_fingerprint: (if $fingerprint == "" then null else $fingerprint end),
     tools: $tools, snapshots: $snapshots, phases: $phases, started: $started, finished: $finished}' \
    > "$META/pipeline.json.tmp" && mv "$META/pipeline.json.tmp" "$META/pipeline.json"
}

finish() {  # finish <status> <exit> [reason]
  STATUS="$1"; [[ -n "${3:-}" ]] && REASON="$3"
  write_pipeline
  FINAL_WRITTEN=1
  remove_tree "$HOME_DIR"
  [[ -n "$REASON" ]] && echo "pipeline-run.sh: $STATUS: $REASON" >&2
  exit "$2"
}
infra() { finish infrastructure_error 2 "$*"; }

on_exit() {
  local rc=$?
  remove_tree "$HOME_DIR"
  if [[ "$FINAL_WRITTEN" -eq 0 ]]; then
    STATUS=infrastructure_error; REASON="${REASON:-driver aborted (rc $rc)}"
    write_pipeline 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 2
  fi
}
kill_phase() {
  [[ -n "$CUR_CONTAINER" ]] && "$DOCKER_BIN" kill --signal TERM "$CUR_CONTAINER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

}
on_signal() { INTERRUPTED=1; kill_phase; }

trap on_signal TERM INT HUP

# --- materialisation (D-4.5) -------------------------------------------------------
resolve_rel() {  # resolve_rel <relpath> → first existing dir among the candidate roots
  local rel="$1" c
  if [[ "$rel" == /* ]]; then [[ -d "$rel" ]] && { printf '%s' "$rel"; return 0; }; return 1; fi
  for c in "$TASK_DIR/$rel" "$SUITE_ROOT/$rel" "$REPO_ROOT/$rel" "$REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rel" "$SOURCE_TREE/evals/fixtures/$rel"; do
    [[ -d "$c" ]] && { (cd "$c" && pwd); return 0; }
  done
  return 1
}
sgit() {  # git on the sandbox repo, isolated from the operator's git config
  env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$META" GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 LC_ALL=C \
    git -C "$WS" "$@"
}

if [[ "$KIND" == build ]]; then
  fx_rel="$(jq -r '.fixture // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"

  case "/$FIXTURE_DIR/" in */hidden/*) infra "fixture resolves inside a hidden directory: $fx_rel" ;; esac
  lib_call check_fixture_path_rule "$FIXTURE_DIR"
  cp -a "$FIXTURE_DIR/." "$WS/"
else
  fx_rel="$(jq -r '.review_catch.fixture // .fixture // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$fx_rel" ]] || infra "review-catch task has no review_catch.fixture"
  FIXTURE_DIR="$(resolve_rel "$fx_rel")" || infra "review-catch fixture not found: $fx_rel"
  mkdir -p "$WS/pr"

fi

  \( -iname hidden -o -iname 'hidden-tests' -o -iname 'hidden.*' \) -print | sed -n '1p')"

leak_scan() {  # leak_scan <file> — `hidden`, a defect key or any arm id → non-zero
  local f="$1" id
  grep -qi 'hidden' "$f" && { echo "the word hidden"; return 1; }
  grep -qE 'D[0-9]{2}-' "$f" && { echo "a defect key"; return 1; }
  while IFS= read -r id; do
    [[ -n "$id" ]] || continue
    grep -qF -e "$id" "$f" && { echo "arm id $id"; return 1; }
  done <<<"$ALL_ARM_IDS"
  return 0
}

done

[[ -z "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-timeouts must be a JSON object"

[[ -n "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON='{}'

TASK_YAML="$(cd "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")" && pwd)/$(basename "$TASK_YAML")"
TASK_DIR="$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")"
SUITE_ROOT="$(cd "$TASK_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || die_usage "suite file does not parse: $SUITE_FILE"

  MAX_RUN_USD="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // 12' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"

fi
[[ "$MAX_RUN_USD" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || die_usage "--max-run-usd must be a number"

# --- arm and phase plan -------------------------------------------------------
ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
ALL_ARM_IDS="$(jq -r '[.arms // [] | .[] | .id] | .[]' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
REFUSAL=""
if [[ -z "$ARM_DEF" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \
       '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
       >/dev/null <<<"$ARM_DEF"; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' does not apply to task type '$TASK_TYPE' (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
fi
[[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || ARM_DEF='{}'
SUITE_TOGGLES="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"

# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
plan_phases() {
  jq -c -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --argjson tg "$1" --arg kind "$KIND" '
    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt
    | ( $arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt ) as $p0
    | ( if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end ) as $p1
    | ( if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end ) as $p2
    | ( if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null
          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3
    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += [{name: "FIX", label: ("FIX" + (.fix | tostring))}]
        else .out += [{name: $n, label: $n}] end)
    | .out'
}

phase_skill() {  # the Loa skill a phase invokes (for effort_requested)
  case "$1" in
    PLAN) echo planning-sprints ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) echo implementing-tasks ;;
    REVIEW) echo reviewing-code ;; AUDIT) echo auditing-security ;; *) echo "" ;;
  esac
}
builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }

phase_model() {
  jq -r --arg n "$1" --arg d "$(builtin_model "$1")" --argjson o "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" \
    '$o[$n] // .phase_defaults.models[$n] // $d' <<<"$SUITE_JSON"
}
phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
  local n="$1" key="$2" v
  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  if [[ -z "$v" && "$n" == "BARE" ]]; then
    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
  fi
  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
  fi
  printf '%s' "$v"
}
phase_timeout_s() {
  local o; o="$(jq -r --arg n "$1" '.[$n] // empty' <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON")"
  if [[ -n "$o" ]]; then printf '%s' "$o"; else printf '%s' $(( $(phase_cap "$1" timeout_min) * 60 )); fi
}
TOOLS="$(jq -r --arg d "$TOOLS_DEFAULT" '.phase_defaults.tools // $d | if type == "array" then join(",") else . end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
EFFORT_FLAG="$(jq -r '.effort // .toggles.effort // empty' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
case "$EFFORT_FLAG" in ""|low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) die_usage "arm effort '$EFFORT_FLAG' is not low|medium|high|xhigh|max" ;; esac

if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == true ]]; then
  if [[ -n "$REFUSAL" ]]; then echo "pipeline-run.sh: refused: $REFUSAL" >&2; exit 2; fi
  plan="$(plan_phases "$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  single="$(jq -r '.context_resets == false' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  echo "plan: task $TASK_ID type $TASK_TYPE arm $ARM executor $EXECUTOR cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD phases $(jq -r 'map(.label + (if .name == "FIX" then "?" else "" end)) | join(",")' <<<"$plan")"
  i=0
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    sess=new
    if [[ "$single" == true ]]; then case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) sess=implementer ;; esac; fi
    cond=""; [[ "$name" == FIX ]] && cond=" when=CHANGES_REQUIRED"
    printf 'phase %d %s model=%s max_turns=%s timeout_s=%s effort=%s session=%s%s\n' "$i" "$label" \
      "$(phase_model "$name")" "$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)" "$(phase_timeout_s "$name")" \
      "${EFFORT_FLAG:--}" "$sess" "$cond"
  done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$plan")
  exit 0
fi

# --- run directory --------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ -e "$RUN_DIR" ]] && [[ -n "$(ls -A "$RUN_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
  die_usage "run dir exists and is not empty: $RUN_DIR"
fi
mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
RUN_DIR="$(cd "$RUN_DIR" && pwd)"
WS="$RUN_DIR/sandbox" META="$RUN_DIR/meta" SNAPS="$RUN_DIR/snapshots" TRANS="$RUN_DIR/transcripts" EVALD="$RUN_DIR/eval"

printf '%s\n' "$ARM" > "$META/arm"

export ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE="$META/arm-evidence.txt"; : > "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
MOUNT_LOG="$META/mount.log"; : > "$MOUNT_LOG"

STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
STATUS="running" CAP_PHASE="" CAP_TURN="null" REASON="" FINAL_WRITTEN=0
INTERRUPTED=0 CUR_PID="" CUR_CONTAINER=""
SPENT_MICRO=0 IMAGE_DIGEST="" FINGERPRINT="" SNAPSHOTS_JSON='{}' TOGGLES="$SUITE_TOGGLES"
SOURCE_COMMIT="$(git -C "$SOURCE_TREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
SUITE_VERSION="$(jq -c --argjson t "$TASK_JSON" '$t.suite_version // .suite_version // .version // null' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
HOME_DIR="$META/home"   # container mode: the per-run writable HOME (deleted at exit)

now_ms() {  # epoch milliseconds; whole seconds × 1000 where date has no %N (BSD date)
  local t; t="$(date +%s%N)"
  case "$t" in *N) printf '%s000' "$(date +%s)" ;; *) printf '%s' "${t:0:13}" ;; esac
}
remove_tree() {  # remove_tree <dir> — permission-tolerant delete (credential copies)
  [[ -e "$1" ]] || return 0
  chmod -R u+rwx "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$1" -depth -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

evidence_json() {
  jq -Rn '[inputs | select(test("^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+=")) | capture("^(?<k>[^=]+)=(?<v>.*)$")]
          | reduce .[] as $e ({}; .[$e.k] = $e.v)' < "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
}

write_pipeline() {  # write_pipeline — (re)write meta/pipeline.json from the current state

  ev="$(evidence_json 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')"

    --arg run_id "$RUN_ID" --arg arm "$ARM" --arg task_id "$TASK_ID" --arg task_type "$TASK_TYPE" \
    --argjson trial "$TRIAL" --arg source_commit "$SOURCE_COMMIT" --argjson suite_version "$SUITE_VERSION" \
    --argjson phases "$phases" --arg status "$STATUS" --arg cap_phase "$CAP_PHASE" --argjson cap_turn "$CAP_TURN" \
    --arg reason "$REASON" --argjson arm_evidence "$ev" --argjson toggles "$TOGGLES" --arg executor "$EXECUTOR" \
    --arg image_digest "$IMAGE_DIGEST" --arg fingerprint "$FINGERPRINT" --arg tools "$TOOLS" \
    --argjson snapshots "$SNAPSHOTS_JSON" --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" \
    --argjson spent "$SPENT_MICRO" --arg cap "$MAX_RUN_USD" --arg effort "$EFFORT_FLAG" '
    {schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, arm: $arm, task_id: $task_id, task_type: $task_type, trial: $trial,
     source_commit: $source_commit, suite_version: $suite_version, status: $status,
     cap_phase: (if $cap_phase == "" then null else $cap_phase end), cap_turn: $cap_turn,
     reason: (if $reason == "" then null else $reason end),
     max_run_usd: ($cap | tonumber), spent_usd: ($spent / 1000000),
     arm_toggles: $toggles, effort_flag: (if $effort == "" then null else $effort end), arm_evidence: $arm_evidence,
     executor_mode: $executor, image_digest: (if $image_digest == "" then null else $image_digest end),

}

finish() {  # finish <status> <exit> [reason]

  FINAL_WRITTEN=1
  remove_tree "$HOME_DIR"
  [[ -n "$REASON" ]] && echo "pipeline-run.sh: $STATUS: $REASON" >&2
  exit "$2"
}
infra() { finish infrastructure_error 2 "$*"; }

on_exit() {

subst() {  # subst <text> <key> <value>
  local text="$1" key="{{$2}}" val="$3"
  printf '%s' "${text//"$key"/$val}"
}
if [[ "$KIND" == review-catch ]]; then
  CHANGE_NOTE="The change under review is the pull request in \`pr/\`: \`pr/head.diff\` is the complete change (base to head), \`pr/base/\` and \`pr/head/\` hold every touched file before and after it, and \`pr/PR.md\` is its description (also carried as the implementation report). Cite findings as \`head/<path>:<line>\` with line numbers from the \`pr/head/\` files. When your skill runs the adversarial dissent, pass \`--diff-file pr/head.diff\`."
else
  CHANGE_NOTE="The change under review is the diff from the base commit \`$BASE_COMMIT\` to the current tree (\`git diff $BASE_COMMIT\`)."
fi
build_prompt() {  # build_prompt <name> <out-file>
  local name="$1" out="$2" tpl text contract tc
  tpl="$(cat "$PROMPTS_DIR/$name.md")"
  if [[ "$name" == BARE ]]; then
    if [[ -f "$TASK_DIR/TASK.md" ]]; then text="$(cat "$TASK_DIR/TASK.md")"
    elif [[ "$KIND" == review-catch && -f "$WS/pr/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md" ]]; then text="$(cat "$WS/pr/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md")"
    else text="$(jq -r '.criterion // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"; fi
    if [[ "$KIND" == review-catch ]]; then
      contract="The pull request is under \`pr/\` (\`pr/PR.md\`, \`pr/head.diff\`, \`pr/base/\`, \`pr/head/\`). Write your findings to \`review.md\` at the repository root: one line per finding as \`head/<path>:<line> — <description>\` with line numbers from the \`pr/head/\` files, and a final line \`Verdict: APPROVED\` or \`Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED\`."
    else
      tc="$(jq -r '.test_command // [] | if type == "array" then join(" ") else . end' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
      contract="Test command: \`$tc\`. Write your changes in place; run the tests; stop when they pass."
    fi
    tpl="$(subst "$tpl" TASK_TEXT "$text")"
    tpl="$(subst "$tpl" CONTRACT "$contract")"
  fi
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" SPRINT "$SPRINT")"
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" TASK_ID "$TASK_ID")"
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" FLATLINE "$FLATLINE")"
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" CHANGE_NOTE "$CHANGE_NOTE")"
  printf '%s\n' "$tpl" > "$out"
}
