# --- pricing (one lookup per model; D-4.10) ---------------------------------------------
PRICE_CACHE=""
price_for() {  # price_for <model id> → {"in":…,"out":…,"cr":…,"cc":…} micro-USD per Mtok, or null
  local m="$1" hit alias j
  hit="$(printf '%s\n' "$PRICE_CACHE" | awk -F'\t' -v m="$m" '$1 == m {print $2; exit}')"
  [[ -n "$hit" ]] && { printf '%s' "$hit"; return 0; }
  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON:-}" ]]; then
    j="$(jq -c --arg m "$m" '.[$m] // null' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
  else
    alias="$(printf '%s' "$m" | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.//; s/-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$//')"
    j="$(cd "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters" && python3 -I "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py" \
          --alias "$alias" --json 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
    [[ -n "$j" ]] || j=null
  fi
  j="$(jq -c 'if (type == "object") and (.input_per_mtok != null) and (.output_per_mtok != null)
              then {in: .input_per_mtok, out: .output_per_mtok,
                    cr: (.cache_read_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 0.1)),
                    cc: (.cache_write_per_mtok // .cache_creation_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 1.25))}
              else null end' <<<"$j" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
  PRICE_CACHE="$PRICE_CACHE$m"$'\t'"$j"$'\n'
  printf '%s' "$j"
}
# price_events <events> <prices> <budget_micro> → "<turns> <estimate_micro> <crossing_turn|0>"
price_events() {
  jq -R -n -r --argjson p "$2" --argjson budget "$3" '
    def cost(u): ((u.input_tokens // 0) * $p.in + (u.output_tokens // 0) * $p.out
                  + (u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cr + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cc) / 1000000;
    reduce (inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant"
                                        and ((.message.usage // null) | type) == "object")) as $e
      ({order: [], u: {}, n: 0};
       .n += 1
       | ($e.message.id // ("event-" + (.n | tostring))) as $id
       | (if .u[$id] == null then .order += [$id] else . end)
       | .u[$id] = $e.message.usage)
    | [.order[] as $id | cost(.u[$id])] as $c
    | (reduce range(0; $c | length) as $i ({s: 0, x: 0};
         if .x == 0 then (.s += $c[$i]) | (if .s >= $budget then .x = ($i + 1) else . end) else . end)) as $r
    | "\($c | length) \(($c | add // 0) | round) \($r.x)"' 2>/dev/null < "$1" || echo "0 0 0"
}

IMPL_SESSION="" LAST_VERDICT="none" CUR_LABEL=""
in_container_path() { local p="$1"; printf '%s' "/workspace${p#"$WS"}"; }

# ENV_SHIM <keys-csv> <cmd…>: close every descriptor above 2 (DEC-0412), keep exactly the
# named environment variables, exec <cmd>. Used on the host (host mode, and around the
# docker client) and inside the container. No eval (eval.yml trust boundary), and secret
# values never appear in any argv: they travel in the environment only.
ENV_SHIM='import os, sys
keys = [k for k in sys.argv[1].split(",") if k]
env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in keys if k in os.environ}
os.closerange(3, 65536)
os.execvpe(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[2:], env)'
# pass-through keys, taken from the driver's environment when set; SECRET_KEYS are never
# written to an argv or a capture (recorded as <set>)
PASS_KEYS="AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL"
SECRET_KEYS=" AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK "

run_phase() {  # run_phase <name> <label>
  local name="$1" label="$2" model turns tsec prompt_file events errf argv_file
  local -a cargv envkv full
  model="$(phase_model "$name")"
  turns="$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)"
  tsec="$(phase_timeout_s "$name")"
  prompt_file="$META/prompt-$label.md"
  events="$TRANS/events-$label.jsonl"; errf="$TRANS/stderr-$label.log"
  argv_file="$META/phase-$label.argv.json"
  build_prompt "$name" "$prompt_file"
  local why; why="$(leak_scan "$prompt_file")" || infra "phase prompt $label leaks $why"

  local resume=""
  if [[ "$SINGLE_SESSION" == true && -n "$IMPL_SESSION" ]]; then
    case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) resume="$IMPL_SESSION" ;; esac
  fi
  local cbin="$CLAUDE_BIN"; [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]] && cbin="${LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
  cargv=("$cbin" -p "$(cat "$prompt_file")" --output-format stream-json --verbose --model "$model"
         --permission-mode bypassPermissions --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project
         --tools "$TOOLS" --max-turns "$turns")
  [[ -n "$EFFORT_FLAG" ]] && cargv+=(--effort "$EFFORT_FLAG")
  [[ -n "$resume" ]] && cargv+=(--resume "$resume")

  local ev_ws="$WS" home_v="$HOME" path_v="$PATH"
  if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]]; then
    ev_ws="/workspace"; home_v="/home/evaluser"; path_v="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
  fi
  envkv=("PATH=$path_v" "HOME=$home_v" "LANG=${LANG:-C.UTF-8}" "LC_ALL=$LC_ALL" "TERM=${TERM:-dumb}"
         "TMPDIR=$ev_ws/.eval/tmp" "CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=${CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK:-1}")
  local pk
  for pk in $PASS_KEYS; do
    if [[ -n "${!pk:-}" ]]; then envkv+=("$pk=${!pk}"); fi
  done
  envkv+=("CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=$model"
          "LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH=$ev_ws/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl"
          "LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH=$ev_ws/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl"
          "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null" "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1" "GH_CONFIG_DIR=$ev_ws/.eval/gh-empty")
  local kv_arm have_enforce=false
  while IFS= read -r kv_arm; do
    [[ "$kv_arm" =~ ^LOA_[A-Z0-9_]+= ]] || continue    # the arm's own variables only (never PATH, HOME, keys)
    envkv+=("$kv_arm"); [[ "$kv_arm" == LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=* ]] && have_enforce=true
  done < <(LC_ALL=C sort -u "$ARM_ENV_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ "$GATES_OFF" == true && "$have_enforce" == false ]] && envkv+=("LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false")

  local cname="" keys="" kv k
  for kv in "${envkv[@]}"; do keys="$keys${keys:+,}${kv%%=*}"; done
  if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]]; then
    cname="loa-abl-$(printf '%s-%s' "$RUN_ID" "$label" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '-' | cut -c1-100)"
    # the docker client keeps only what it needs plus the secrets it forwards by name
    local hostkeys="PATH,HOME,DOCKER_HOST,DOCKER_CONFIG,XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
    for k in $SECRET_KEYS; do if [[ -n "${!k:-}" ]]; then hostkeys="$hostkeys,$k"; fi; done
    full=(python3 -I -c "$ENV_SHIM" "$hostkeys"
          "$DOCKER_BIN" run --rm --name "$cname" --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)"
          --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g
          --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
          -v "$WS:/workspace:rw"
          -v "$HOME_DIR:/home/evaluser:rw"
          -w /workspace)
    for kv in "${envkv[@]}"; do
      k="${kv%%=*}"
      if [[ "$SECRET_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]]; then full+=(-e "$k"); else full+=(-e "$kv"); fi
    done
    full+=("$IMAGE" python3 -I -c "$ENV_SHIM" "$keys" timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15 "$tsec" "${cargv[@]}")
  else
    full=(python3 -I -c "$ENV_SHIM" "$keys" timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15 "$tsec" "${cargv[@]}")
  fi

  # argv + environment capture (took-effect.sh reads it; the grader never does)
  jq -n --arg label "$label" --arg name "$name" --arg executor "$EXECUTOR" --arg cwd "$ev_ws" \
    --arg resume "$resume" --argjson tsec "$tsec" \
    --argjson argv "$(printf '%s\0' "${cargv[@]}" | jq -Rs 'split("\u0000") | .[:-1]')" \
    --argjson env "$(printf '%s\0' "${envkv[@]}" | jq -Rs --arg secret "$SECRET_KEYS" 'split("\u0000") | .[:-1]
        | map(capture("^(?<k>[^=]+)=(?<v>.*)$"; "s")) | map(.k as $k | {($k): (if ($secret | contains(" " + $k + " ")) then "<set>" else .v end)}) | add')" \
    --argjson launcher "$(printf '%s\0' "${full[@]}" | jq -Rs 'split("\u0000") | .[:-1]')" \
    '{label: $label, name: $name, executor: $executor, cwd: $cwd, timeout_s: $tsec,
      resume: (if $resume == "" then null else $resume end), argv: $argv, env: $env,
      launcher_argv: $launcher, container: ($executor == "container")}' > "$argv_file"

  local ledger_before=0 started_iso start_s end_s rc=0 prices killed=0 cap_turn=0 est="0 0 0" budget
  ledger_before="$(wc -l < "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" | tr -d ' ')"
  local minv_before minv_after
  minv_before="$(wc -l < "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl" | tr -d ' ')"
  started_iso="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  start_s="$(now_ms)"
  prices="$(price_for "$model")"
  budget=$(( CAP_MICRO - SPENT_MICRO ))
  CUR_LABEL="$label" CUR_CONTAINER="$cname"
  # the allowlist values enter the launcher's environment by export (never argv); the
  # shim then keeps exactly the allowlist (host) or the docker client's keys (container)
  ( cd "$WS" || exit 2
    if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == host ]]; then for kv in "${envkv[@]}"; do export "$kv"; done; fi
    exec "${full[@]}" ) < /dev/null > "$events" 2> "$errf" &
  CUR_PID=$!
  local poll="${LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S:-1}"
  while kill -0 "$CUR_PID" 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep "$poll" || true
    [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]] && break
    if [[ "$prices" != null ]]; then
      est="$(price_events "$events" "$prices" "$budget")"
      if [[ "${est##* }" -gt 0 ]]; then
        killed=1; cap_turn="${est##* }"
        echo "pipeline-run.sh: watchdog: $label estimate passes the cap at turn $cap_turn; SIGTERM" >&2
        kill_phase
        break
      fi
    fi
  done
  wait "$CUR_PID" 2>/dev/null || rc=$?
  # a trapped signal interrupts `wait` (status > 128, child still a job): wait for
  # the child to go, then reap its real status (127 = already reaped)
  if [[ $rc -gt 128 && "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]]; then
    while kill -0 "$CUR_PID" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.2; done
    local rc2=0; wait "$CUR_PID" 2>/dev/null || rc2=$?
    [[ $rc2 -ne 127 ]] && rc=$rc2
  fi
  end_s="$(now_ms)"
  CUR_PID="" CUR_CONTAINER=""
  [[ "$prices" != null ]] && est="$(price_events "$events" "$prices" "$budget")"

  # --- record ---
  local result init_sid sid ledger_rows ledger_micro rf timed_out=false elapsed_ms
  elapsed_ms=$(( end_s - start_s ))
  result="$(grep -E '^\{.*"type" *: *"result"' "$events" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '$p' || true)"
  if [[ -z "$result" ]] || ! jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$result"; then
    result='{"type":"result","subtype":"missing","is_error":true}'
  fi
  init_sid="$(jq -R -r 'fromjson? | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init") | .session_id // empty' "$events" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
  sid="${init_sid:-$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' <<<"$result")}"
  if [[ "$SINGLE_SESSION" == true && -z "$IMPL_SESSION" && -n "$sid" ]]; then
    case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) IMPL_SESSION="$sid" ;; esac
  fi
  rf="$(jq -R -c 'fromjson? | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "model_refusal_fallback")
        | {from: (.original_model // null), to: (.fallback_model // null), category: (.api_refusal_category // null), scope: (.scope // null)}' \
        "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc '.' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
  [[ -n "$rf" ]] || rf='[]'
  ledger_rows="$(sed -n "$((ledger_before + 1)),\$p" "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  ledger_micro="$(printf '%s\n' "$ledger_rows" | jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
        | (.cost_micro_usd // ((.cost_usd // 0) * 1000000))] | add // 0 | round' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  minv_after="$(wc -l < "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl" | tr -d ' ')"
  cp "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl" "$EVALD/model-invoke.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
  cp "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" "$EVALD/cost-ledger.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
  local env_f
  for env_f in "$WS"/grimoires/loa/a2a/"$SPRINT"/adversarial-*.json; do
    [[ -f "$env_f" ]] && cp "$env_f" "$EVALD/"
  done
  if [[ $rc -eq 124 ]] || { [[ $rc -eq 137 ]] && [[ $elapsed_ms -ge $(( tsec * 1000 )) ]]; }; then timed_out=true; fi

  local snap="" verdict=null skill effort_req
  if [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 0 ]] && { [[ "$name" == IMPLEMENT ]] || [[ "$name" == FIX ]]; }; then
    sgit add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sgit commit -q --allow-empty -m "snapshot $label" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    snap="$(sgit rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "$snap" ]]; then
      sgit bundle create "$SNAPS/$label.bundle" HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      SNAPSHOTS_JSON="$(jq -c --arg k "$(printf '%s' "$label" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" --arg v "$snap" '.[$k] = $v' <<<"$SNAPSHOTS_JSON")"
      jq -n --argjson s "$SNAPSHOTS_JSON" --arg base "$BASE_COMMIT" '$s + {base: $base}' > "$SNAPS/index.json"
    fi
  fi
  case "$name" in
    REVIEW) verdict="$(gate_verdict "$WS/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT/engineer-feedback.md")" ;;
    AUDIT)  verdict="$(gate_verdict "$WS/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT/auditor-sprint-feedback.md")" ;;
  esac
  if [[ "$name" == REVIEW || "$name" == AUDIT ]]; then LAST_VERDICT="$verdict"; fi
  # Sprint 258 smoke (lead, DEC-0490): a gate that exhausted --max-turns AFTER writing its LOA-VERDICT
  # trailer has delivered its result; the extra turns were housekeeping. Count the phase as completed
  # with turn_cap_hit=true and keep the CLI's exit in cli_exit. Any other phase keeps the error.
  local subtype turn_cap_hit=false gate_recovered=false cli_exit="$rc"
  subtype="$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' <<<"$result")"
  [[ "$subtype" == error_max_turns ]] && turn_cap_hit=true
  if [[ "$turn_cap_hit" == true && $rc -ne 0 && "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 0 ]] && { [[ "$name" == REVIEW ]] || [[ "$name" == AUDIT ]]; } \
     && [[ -n "$verdict" && "$verdict" != none && "$verdict" != null ]]; then
    gate_recovered=true; rc=0
  fi
  skill="$(phase_skill "$name")"
  effort_req="$EFFORT_FLAG"
  if [[ -z "$effort_req" && -n "$skill" && -f "$WS/.claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md" ]]; then
    effort_req="$(awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---"{exit} NR>1 && $0=="---"{exit} NR>1 && /^effort:/{sub(/^effort:[[:space:]]*/,""); gsub(/["'\'' ]/,""); print; exit}' \
      "$WS/.claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md")"
  fi

  local est_turns est_micro
  est_turns="$(printf '%s' "$est" | awk '{print $1}')"; est_micro="$(printf '%s' "$est" | awk '{print $2}')"
  jq -cn --arg name "$name" --arg label "$label" --arg sid "$sid" --arg model "$model" --arg effort "$effort_req" \
    --argjson result "$result" --argjson rf "$rf" --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson dur "$elapsed_ms" \
    --arg snap "$snap" --arg verdict "$verdict" --arg resume "$resume" --arg started "$started_iso" \
    --arg finished "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson ledger "$ledger_micro" --argjson timed_out "$timed_out" \
    --argjson killed "$killed" --argjson cap_turn "$cap_turn" --argjson est_turns "${est_turns:-0}" \
    --argjson est_micro "${est_micro:-0}" --argjson turns "$turns" --argjson tsec "$tsec" --arg priced "$prices" \
    --argjson minv_from "$((minv_before + 1))" --argjson minv_to "$minv_after" \
    --argjson ledger_from "$((ledger_before + 1))" --argjson turn_cap_hit "$turn_cap_hit" \
    --argjson gate_recovered "$gate_recovered" --argjson cli_exit "$cli_exit" '
    def u(k1; k2): ($result.usage[k1] // $result.usage[k2] // 0);
    {name: $name, label: $label, skipped: false,
     session_id: (if $sid == "" then null else $sid end),
     resumed_from: (if $resume == "" then null else $resume end),
     model_requested: $model,
     models_used: (($result.modelUsage // {}) | with_entries(.value = (.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0))),
     effort_requested: (if $effort == "" then null else $effort end),
     tokens_in: u("input_tokens"; "inputTokens"), tokens_out: u("output_tokens"; "outputTokens"),
     cache_read_tokens: u("cache_read_input_tokens"; "cacheReadInputTokens"),
     cache_creation_tokens: u("cache_creation_input_tokens"; "cacheCreationInputTokens"),
     cost_usd: ($result.total_cost_usd // ($est_micro / 1000000)),
     cost_source: (if $result.total_cost_usd != null then "result" else "watchdog_estimate" end),
     ledger_cost_usd: ($ledger / 1000000),
     duration_ms: ($result.duration_ms // $dur), wall_ms: $dur,
     num_turns: ($result.num_turns // $est_turns), max_turns: $turns, timeout_s: $tsec,
     exit: $rc, cli_exit: $cli_exit, timed_out: $timed_out, is_error: (($result.is_error // false) or ($rc != 0)),
     result_subtype: ($result.subtype // null), turn_cap_hit: $turn_cap_hit, gate_recovered: $gate_recovered,
     refusal_fallbacks: $rf,
     modelinv_lines: {from: $minv_from, to: $minv_to},
     ledger_lines_from: $ledger_from,
     snapshot: (if $snap == "" then null else $snap end),
     verdict: (if $verdict == "null" or $verdict == "" then null else $verdict end),
     watchdog: {priced: ($priced != "null"), estimate_usd: ($est_micro / 1000000), turns_seen: $est_turns,
                killed: ($killed == 1), cap_turn: (if $killed == 1 then $cap_turn else null end)},
     started: $started, finished: $finished}' >> "$PHASES_FILE"

  # --- account and decide ---
  local cost_micro
  cost_micro="$(jq -r --argjson e "${est_micro:-0}" '(.total_cost_usd // ($e / 1000000)) * 1000000 | round' <<<"$result")"
  SPENT_MICRO=$(( SPENT_MICRO + cost_micro + ledger_micro ))
  if [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]]; then finish interrupted 4 "driver received a signal during $label"; fi
  if [[ "$killed" -eq 1 ]]; then CAP_PHASE="$label"; CAP_TURN="$cap_turn"; finish cap_failure 3 "watchdog stopped $label at turn $cap_turn"; fi
  if [[ "$timed_out" == false ]] && { [[ $rc -eq 143 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 137 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 129 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 130 ]]; }; then
    finish interrupted 4 "phase $label was killed from outside (exit $rc)"
  fi
  if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]]; then
    if [[ "$timed_out" == true ]]; then finish agent_error 1 "phase $label timed out after ${tsec}s"; fi
    finish agent_error 1 "phase $label exited $rc"
  fi
  if [[ $SPENT_MICRO -ge $CAP_MICRO ]]; then
    CAP_PHASE="$label"; finish cap_failure 3 "spend USD $(jq -n --argjson s "$SPENT_MICRO" '$s/1000000') reached the cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD after $label"
  fi
  write_pipeline
}

gate_verdict() {  # gate_verdict <feedback.md> → APPROVED | CHANGES_REQUIRED | none
  local f="$1" line v
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || { echo none; return 0; }
  line="$(awk '/<!-- LOA-VERDICT \{.*\} -->[[:space:]]*$/ {l=$0} END {print l}' "$f")"
  [[ -n "$line" ]] || { echo none; return 0; }
  line="${line#*<!-- LOA-VERDICT }"; line="${line% -->*}"
  v="$(jq -r '.verdict // "none"' <<<"$line" 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
  case "$v" in APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED) echo "$v" ;; *) echo none ;; esac
}

record_skip() {  # record_skip <name> <label> <reason>
  jq -cn --arg name "$1" --arg label "$2" --arg why "$3" \
    '{name: $name, label: $label, skipped: true, reason: $why, session_id: null, exit: null, cost_usd: 0}' >> "$PHASES_FILE"
}

PLAN_NAMES=() PLAN_LABELS=()
while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
  PLAN_NAMES+=("$name"); PLAN_LABELS+=("$label")
done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$PLAN_JSON")
[[ ${#PLAN_NAMES[@]} -gt 0 ]] || infra "the phase plan is empty"
for name in "${PLAN_NAMES[@]}"; do
  [[ -f "$PROMPTS_DIR/$name.md" ]] || infra "no phase prompt for $name"
done

write_pipeline
i=0
while [[ $i -lt ${#PLAN_NAMES[@]} ]]; do
  name="${PLAN_NAMES[$i]}" label="${PLAN_LABELS[$i]}"
  i=$((i + 1))
  [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]] && finish interrupted 4 "driver received a signal before $label"
  if [[ "$name" == FIX && "$LAST_VERDICT" != CHANGES_REQUIRED ]]; then
    record_skip "$name" "$label" "preceding gate verdict $LAST_VERDICT"
    continue
  fi
  run_phase "$name" "$label"
done

finish completed 0

tool_use_result.stdout:
why="$(leak_scan "$WS/grimoires/loa/context/task-brief.md")" || infra "task-brief.md leaks $why"
fi

# --- prompts (D-4.4) -----------------------------------------------------------------
subst() {  # subst <text> <key> <value>
  local text="$1" key="{{$2}}" val="$3"
  printf '%s' "${text//"$key"/$val}"
}
if [[ "$KIND" == review-catch ]]; then
  CHANGE_NOTE="The change under review is the pull request in \`pr/\`: \`pr/head.diff\` is the complete change (base to head), \`pr/base/\` and \`pr/head/\` hold every touched file before and after it, and \`pr/PR.md\` is its description (also carried as the implementation report). Cite findings as \`head/<path>:<line>\` with line numbers from the \`pr/head/\` files. When your skill runs the adversarial dissent, pass \`--diff-file pr/head.diff\`."
else
  CHANGE_NOTE="The change under review is the diff from the base commit \`$BASE_COMMIT\` to the current tree (\`git diff $BASE_COMMIT\`)."
fi
build_prompt() {  # build_prompt <name> <out-file>
  local name="$1" out="$2" tpl text contract tc
  tpl="$(cat "$PROMPTS_DIR/$name.md")"
  if [[ "$name" == BARE ]]; then
    if [[ -f "$TASK_DIR/TASK.md" ]]; then text="$(cat "$TASK_DIR/TASK.md")"
    elif [[ "$KIND" == review-catch && -f "$WS/pr/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md" ]]; then text="$(cat "$WS/pr/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md")"
    else text="$(jq -r '.criterion // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"; fi
    if [[ "$KIND" == review-catch ]]; then
      contract="The pull request is under \`pr/\` (\`pr/PR.md\`, \`pr/head.diff\`, \`pr/base/\`, \`pr/head/\`). Write your findings to \`review.md\` at the repository root: one line per finding as \`head/<path>:<line> — <description>\` with line numbers from the \`pr/head/\` files, and a final line \`Verdict: APPROVED\` or \`Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED\`."
    else
      tc="$(jq -r '.test_command // [] | if type == "array" then join(" ") else . end' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
      contract="Test command: \`$tc\`. Write your changes in place; run the tests; stop when they pass."
    fi
    tpl="$(subst "$tpl" TASK_TEXT "$text")"
    tpl="$(subst "$tpl" CONTRACT "$contract")"
  fi
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" SPRINT "$SPRINT")"
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" TASK_ID "$TASK_ID")"
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" FLATLINE "$FLATLINE")"
  tpl="$(subst "$tpl" CHANGE_NOTE "$CHANGE_NOTE")"
  printf '%s\n' "$tpl" > "$out"
}

# --- per-run HOME (container mode; DEC-0411 as amended in Sprint 258) -------------------------
# One writable host directory mounted at /home/evaluser: the CLI's session store lives
# there for the whole run (A6 --resume continues across phases), and it holds only the
# codex CLI's own files. ~/.claude/.credentials.json and ~/.claude/settings.json are never
# copied: the Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK in the environment,
# and --setting-sources project ignores user settings.
CREDS_HOME="${LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME:-$HOME}"
make_home() {
  local f
  mkdir -p "$HOME_DIR/.claude" "$HOME_DIR/.aws" "$HOME_DIR/.codex"
  # the sandbox project is pre-trusted so the mounted tree's project settings apply without the dialog
  # (the CLI otherwise ignores permissions.allow and warns; lead, Sprint 258 smoke)
  printf '{"projects":{"/workspace":{"hasTrustDialogAccepted":true}}}\n' > "$HOME_DIR/.claude.json"
  for f in auth.json config.toml; do
    if [[ -f "$CREDS_HOME/.codex/$f" ]]; then cp "$CREDS_HOME/.codex/$f" "$HOME_DIR/.codex/$f"; fi
  done
  chmod 0700 "$HOME_DIR" "$HOME_DIR/.claude" "$HOME_DIR/.aws" "$HOME_DIR/.codex"
}
[[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]] && make_home

# --- pricing (one lookup per model; D-4.10) ---------------------------------------------
PRICE_CACHE=""
price_for() {  # price_for <model id> → {"in":…,"out":…,"cr":…,"cc":…} micro-USD per Mtok, or null
  local m="$1" hit alias j
  hit="$(printf '%s\n' "$PRICE_CACHE" | awk -F'\t' -v m="$m" '$1 == m {print $2; exit}')"
  [[ -n "$hit" ]] && { printf '%s' "$hit"; return 0; }
  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON:-}" ]]; then
    j="$(jq -c --arg m "$m" '.[$m] // null' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
  else
    alias="$(printf '%s' "$m" | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.//; s/-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$//')"
    j="$(cd "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters" && python3 -I "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py" \
          --alias "$alias" --json 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
    [[ -n "$j" ]] || j=null
  fi
  j="$(jq -c 'if (type == "object") and (.input_per_mtok != null) and (.output_per_mtok != null)
              then {in: .input_per_mtok, out: .output_per_mtok,
                    cr: (.cache_read_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 0.1)),
                    cc: (.cache_write_per_mtok // .cache_creation_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 1.25))}
              else null end' <<<"$j" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
  PRICE_CACHE="$PRICE_CACHE$m"$'\t'"$j"$'\n'
  printf '%s' "$j"
}
# price_events <events> <prices> <budget_micro> → "<turns> <estimate_micro> <crossing_turn|0>"
price_events() {
  jq -R -n -r --argjson p "$2" --argjson budget "$3" '
    def cost(u): ((u.input_tokens // 0) * $p.in + (u.output_tokens // 0) * $p.out
                  + (u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cr + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cc) / 1000000;
    reduce (inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant"
                                        and ((.message.usage // null) | type) == "object")) as $e
      ({order: [], u: {}, n: 0};
       .n += 1
       | ($e.message.id // ("event-" + (.n | tostring))) as $id
       | (if .u[$id] == null then .order += [$id] else . end)
       | .u[$id] = $e.message.usage)
    | [.order[] as $id | cost(.u[$id])] as $c
    | (reduce range(0; $c | length) as $i ({s: 0, x: 0};
         if .x == 0 then (.s += $c[$i]) | (if .s >= $budget then .x = ($i + 1) else . end) else . end)) as $r
    | "\($c | length) \(($c | add // 0) | round) \($r.x)"' 2>/dev/null < "$1" || echo "0 0 0"
}

# --- phase execution ----------------------------------------------------------------
IMPL_SESSION="" LAST_VERDICT="none" CUR_LABEL=""
in_container_path() { local p="$1"; printf '%s' "/workspace${p#"$WS"}"; }

# ENV_SHIM <keys-csv> <cmd…>: close every descriptor above 2 (DEC-0412), keep exactly the
# named environment variables, exec <cmd>. Used on the host (host mode, and around the
# docker client) and inside the container. No eval (eval.yml trust boundary), and secret
# values never appear in any argv: they travel in the environment only.
ENV_SHIM='import os, sys
keys = [k for k in sys.argv[1].split(",") if k]
env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in keys if k in os.environ}
os.closerange(3, 65536)
os.execvpe(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[2:], env)'
# pass-through keys, taken from the driver's environment when set; SECRET_KEYS are never
# written to an argv or a capture (recorded as <set>)
PASS_KEYS="AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL"
SECRET_KEYS=" AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK "

run_phase() {  # run_phase <name> <label>
  local name="$1" label="$2" model turns tsec prompt_file events errf argv_file
  local -a cargv envkv full
  model="$(phase_model "$name")"
  turns="$(phase_cap "$name" max_turns)"
  tsec="$(phase_timeout_s "$name")"
  prompt_file="$META/prompt-$label.md"
  events="$TRANS/events-$label.jsonl"; errf="$TRANS/stderr-$label.log"
  argv_file="$META/phase-$label.argv.json"
  build_prompt "$name" "$prompt_file"
  local why; why="$(leak_scan "$prompt_file")" || infra "phase prompt $label leaks $why"

  local resume=""
  if [[ "$SINGLE_SESSION" == true && -n "$IMPL_SESSION" ]]; then
    case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) resume="$IMPL_SESSION" ;; esac
  fi
  local cbin="$CLAUDE_BIN"; [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]] && cbin="${LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
  cargv=("$cbin" -p "$(cat "$prompt_file")" --output-format stream-json --verbose --model "$model"
         --permission-mode bypassPermissions --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project
         --tools "$TOOLS" --max-turns "$turns")
  [[ -n "$EFFORT_FLAG" ]] && cargv+=(--effort "$EFFORT_FLAG")
  [[ -n "$resume" ]] && cargv+=(--resume "$resume")

  local ev_ws="$WS" home_v="$HOME" path_v="$PATH"
  if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]]; then
    ev_ws="/workspace"; home_v="/home/evaluser"; path_v="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
  fi
  envkv=("PATH=$path_v" "HOME=$home_v" "LANG=${LANG:-C.UTF-8}" "LC_ALL=$LC_ALL" "TERM=${TERM:-dumb}"
         "TMPDIR=$ev_ws/.eval/tmp" "CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=${CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK:-1}")
  local pk
  for pk in $PASS_KEYS; do
    if [[ -n "${!pk:-}" ]]; then envkv+=("$pk=${!pk}"); fi
  done
  envkv+=("CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=$model"
          "LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH=$ev_ws/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl"
          "LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH=$ev_ws/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl"
          "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null" "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1" "GH_CONFIG_DIR=$ev_ws/.eval/gh-empty")
  local kv_arm have_enforce=false
  while IFS= read -r kv_arm; do
    [[ "$kv_arm" =~ ^LOA_[A-Z0-9_]+= ]] || continue    # the arm's own variables only (never PATH, HOME, keys)
    envkv+=("$kv_arm"); [[ "$kv_arm" == LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=* ]] && have_enforce=true
  done < <(LC_ALL=C sort -u "$ARM_ENV_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ "$GATES_OFF" == true && "$have_enforce" == false ]] && envkv+=("LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false")

  local cname="" keys="" kv k
  for kv in "${envkv[@]}"; do keys="$keys${keys:+,}${kv%%=*}"; done
  if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]]; then
    cname="loa-abl-$(printf '%s-%s' "$RUN_ID" "$label" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '-' | cut -c1-100)"
    # the docker client keeps only what it needs plus the secrets it forwards by name
    local hostkeys="PATH,HOME,DOCKER_HOST,DOCKER_CONFIG,XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
    for k in $SECRET_KEYS; do if [[ -n "${!k:-}" ]]; then hostkeys="$hostkeys,$k"; fi; done
    full=(python3 -I -c "$ENV_SHIM" "$hostkeys"
          "$DOCKER_BIN" run --rm --name "$cname" --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)"
          --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g
          --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
          -v "$WS:/workspace:rw"
          -v "$HOME_DIR:/home/evaluser:rw"
          -w /workspace)
    for kv in "${envkv[@]}"; do
      k="${kv%%=*}"
      if [[ "$SECRET_KEYS" == *" $k "* ]]; then full+=(-e "$k"); else full+=(-e "$kv"); fi
    done
    full+=("$IMAGE" python3 -I -c "$ENV_SHIM" "$keys" timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15 "$tsec" "${cargv[@]}")
  else
    full=(python3 -I -c "$ENV_SHIM" "$keys" timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15 "$tsec" "${cargv[@]}")
  fi

  # argv + environment capture (took-effect.sh reads it; the grader never does)
  jq -n --arg label "$label" --arg name "$name" --arg executor "$EXECUTOR" --arg cwd "$ev_ws" \
    --arg resume "$resume" --argjson tsec "$tsec" \
    --argjson argv "$(printf '%s\0' "${cargv[@]}" | jq -Rs 'split("\u0000") | .[:-1]')" \
    --argjson env "$(printf '%s\0' "${envkv[@]}" | jq -Rs --arg secret "$SECRET_KEYS" 'split("\u0000") | .[:-1]
        | map(capture("^(?<k>[^=]+)=(?<v>.*)$"; "s")) | map(.k as $k | {($k): (if ($secret | contains(" " + $k + " ")) then "<set>" else .v end)}) | add')" \
    --argjson launcher "$(printf '%s\0' "${full[@]}" | jq -Rs 'split("\u0000") | .[:-1]')" \
    '{label: $label, name: $name, executor: $executor, cwd: $cwd, timeout_s: $tsec,
      resume: (if $resume == "" then null else $resume end), argv: $argv, env: $env,
      launcher_argv: $launcher, container: ($executor == "container")}' > "$argv_file"

  local ledger_before=0 started_iso start_s end_s rc=0 prices killed=0 cap_turn=0 est="0 0 0" budget
  ledger_before="$(wc -l < "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" | tr -d ' ')"
  local minv_before minv_after
  minv_before="$(wc -l < "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl" | tr -d ' ')"
  started_iso="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  start_s="$(now_ms)"
  prices="$(price_for "$model")"
  budget=$(( CAP_MICRO - SPENT_MICRO ))
  CUR_LABEL="$label" CUR_CONTAINER="$cname"
  # the allowlist values enter the launcher's environment by export (never argv); the
  # shim then keeps exactly the allowlist (host) or the docker client's keys (container)
  ( cd "$WS" || exit 2
    if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == host ]]; then for kv in "${envkv[@]}"; do export "$kv"; done; fi
    exec "${full[@]}" ) < /dev/null > "$events" 2> "$errf" &
  CUR_PID=$!
  local poll="${LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S:-1}"
  while kill -0 "$CUR_PID" 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep "$poll" || true
    [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]] && break
    if [[ "$prices" != null ]]; then
      est="$(price_events "$events" "$prices" "$budget")"
      if [[ "${est##* }" -gt 0 ]]; then
        killed=1; cap_turn="${est##* }"
        echo "pipeline-run.sh: watchdog: $label estimate passes the cap at turn $cap_turn; SIGTERM" >&2
        kill_phase
        break
      fi
    fi
  done
  wait "$CUR_PID" 2>/dev/null || rc=$?
  # a trapped signal interrupts `wait` (status > 128, child still a job): wait for
  # the child to go, then reap its real status (127 = already reaped)
  if [[ $rc -gt 128 && "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]]; then
    while kill -0 "$CUR_PID" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.2; done
    local rc2=0; wait "$CUR_PID" 2>/dev/null || rc2=$?
    [[ $rc2 -ne 127 ]] && rc=$rc2
  fi
  end_s="$(now_ms)"
  CUR_PID="" CUR_CONTAINER=""
  [[ "$prices" != null ]] && est="$(price_events "$events" "$prices" "$budget")"

  # --- record ---
  local result init_sid sid ledger_rows ledger_micro rf timed_out=false elapsed_ms
  elapsed_ms=$(( end_s - start_s ))
  result="$(grep -E '^\{.*"type" *: *"result"' "$events" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '$p' || true)"
  if [[ -z "$result" ]] || ! jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$result"; then
    result='{"type":"result","subtype":"missing","is_error":true}'
  fi
  init_sid="$(jq -R -r 'fromjson? | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init") | .session_id // empty' "$events" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
  sid="${init_sid:-$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' <<<"$result")}"

    case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) IMPL_SESSION="$sid" ;; esac
  fi
  rf="$(jq -R -c 'fromjson? | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "model_refusal_fallback")
        | {from: (.original_model // null), to: (.fallback_model // null), category: (.api_refusal_category // null), scope: (.scope // null)}' \
        "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc '.' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
  [[ -n "$rf" ]] || rf='[]'
  ledger_rows="$(sed -n "$((ledger_before + 1)),\$p" "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  ledger_micro="$(printf '%s\n' "$ledger_rows" | jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
        | (.cost_micro_usd // ((.cost_usd // 0) * 1000000))] | add // 0 | round' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  minv_after="$(wc -l < "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl" | tr -d ' ')"
  cp "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl" "$EVALD/model-invoke.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
  cp "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" "$EVALD/cost-ledger.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
  local env_f
  for env_f in "$WS"/grimoires/loa/a2a/"$SPRINT"/adversarial-*.json; do
    [[ -f "$env_f" ]] && cp "$env_f" "$EVALD/"
  done
  if [[ $rc -eq 124 ]] || { [[ $rc -eq 137 ]] && [[ $elapsed_ms -ge $(( tsec * 1000 )) ]]; }; then timed_out=true; fi

  local snap="" verdict=null skill effort_req
  if [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 0 ]] && { [[ "$name" == IMPLEMENT ]] || [[ "$name" == FIX ]]; }; then
    sgit add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sgit commit -q --allow-empty -m "snapshot $label" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    snap="$(sgit rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "$snap" ]]; then
      sgit bundle create "$SNAPS/$label.bundle" HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      SNAPSHOTS_JSON="$(jq -c --arg k "$(printf '%s' "$label" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" --arg v "$snap" '.[$k] = $v' <<<"$SNAPSHOTS_JSON")"
      jq -n --argjson s "$SNAPSHOTS_JSON" --arg base "$BASE_COMMIT" '$s + {base: $base}' > "$SNAPS/index.json"
    fi
  fi
  case "$name" in
    REVIEW) verdict="$(gate_verdict "$WS/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT/engineer-feedback.md")" ;;
    AUDIT)  verdict="$(gate_verdict "$WS/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT/auditor-sprint-feedback.md")" ;;
  esac
  if [[ "$name" == REVIEW || "$name" == AUDIT ]]; then LAST_VERDICT="$verdict"; fi

  # trailer has delivered its result; the extra turns were housekeeping. Count the phase as completed
  # with turn_cap_hit=true and keep the CLI's exit in cli_exit. Any other phase keeps the error.
  local subtype turn_cap_hit=false gate_recovered=false cli_exit="$rc"
  subtype="$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' <<<"$result")"
  [[ "$subtype" == error_max_turns ]] && turn_cap_hit=true
  if [[ "$turn_cap_hit" == true && $rc -ne 0 && "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 0 ]] && { [[ "$name" == REVIEW ]] || [[ "$name" == AUDIT ]]; } \
     && [[ -n "$verdict" && "$verdict" != none && "$verdict" != null ]]; then
    gate_recovered=true; rc=0
  fi

  effort_req="$EFFORT_FLAG"
  if [[ -z "$effort_req" && -n "$skill" && -f "$WS/.claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md" ]]; then
    effort_req="$(awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---"{exit} NR>1 && $0=="---"{exit} NR>1 && /^effort:/{sub(/^effort:[[:space:]]*/,""); gsub(/["'\'' ]/,""); print; exit}' \
      "$WS/.claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md")"
  fi

  local est_turns est_micro
  est_turns="$(printf '%s' "$est" | awk '{print $1}')"; est_micro="$(printf '%s' "$est" | awk '{print $2}')"
  jq -cn --arg name "$name" --arg label "$label" --arg sid "$sid" --arg model "$model" --arg effort "$effort_req" \
    --argjson result "$result" --argjson rf "$rf" --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson dur "$elapsed_ms" \
    --arg snap "$snap" --arg verdict "$verdict" --arg resume "$resume" --arg started "$started_iso" \
    --arg finished "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson ledger "$ledger_micro" --argjson timed_out "$timed_out" \
    --argjson killed "$killed" --argjson cap_turn "$cap_turn" --argjson est_turns "${est_turns:-0}" \
    --argjson est_micro "${est_micro:-0}" --argjson turns "$turns" --argjson tsec "$tsec" --arg priced "$prices" \
    --argjson minv_from "$((minv_before + 1))" --argjson minv_to "$minv_after" \
    --argjson ledger_from "$((ledger_before + 1))" --argjson turn_cap_hit "$turn_cap_hit" \
    --argjson gate_recovered "$gate_recovered" --argjson cli_exit "$cli_exit" '
    def u(k1; k2): ($result.usage[k1] // $result.usage[k2] // 0);
    {name: $name, label: $label, skipped: false,
     session_id: (if $sid == "" then null else $sid end),
     resumed_from: (if $resume == "" then null else $resume end),
     model_requested: $model,
     models_used: (($result.modelUsage // {}) | with_entries(.value = (.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0))),
     effort_requested: (if $effort == "" then null else $effort end),
     tokens_in: u("input_tokens"; "inputTokens"), tokens_out: u("output_tokens"; "outputTokens"),
     cache_read_tokens: u("cache_read_input_tokens"; "cacheReadInputTokens"),
     cache_creation_tokens: u("cache_creation_input_tokens"; "cacheCreationInputTokens"),
     cost_usd: ($result.total_cost_usd // ($est_micro / 1000000)),
     cost_source: (if $result.total_cost_usd != null then "result" else "watchdog_estimate" end),
     ledger_cost_usd: ($ledger / 1000000),
     duration_ms: ($result.duration_ms // $dur), wall_ms: $dur,
     num_turns: ($result.num_turns // $est_turns), max_turns: $turns, timeout_s: $tsec,
     exit: $rc, cli_exit: $cli_exit, timed_out: $timed_out, is_error: (($result.is_error // false) or ($rc != 0)),
     result_subtype: ($result.subtype // null), turn_cap_hit: $turn_cap_hit, gate_recovered: $gate_recovered,
     refusal_fallbacks: $rf,
     modelinv_lines: {from: $minv_from, to: $minv_to},
     ledger_lines_from: $ledger_from,
     snapshot: (if $snap == "" then null else $snap end),
     verdict: (if $verdict == "null" or $verdict == "" then null else $verdict end),
     watchdog: {priced: ($priced != "null"), estimate_usd: ($est_micro / 1000000), turns_seen: $est_turns,
                killed: ($killed == 1), cap_turn: (if $killed == 1 then $cap_turn else null end)},
     started: $started, finished: $finished}' >> "$PHASES_FILE"

  # --- account and decide ---
  local cost_micro
  cost_micro="$(jq -r --argjson e "${est_micro:-0}" '(.total_cost_usd // ($e / 1000000)) * 1000000 | round' <<<"$result")"
  SPENT_MICRO=$(( SPENT_MICRO + cost_micro + ledger_micro ))
  if [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]]; then finish interrupted 4 "driver received a signal during $label"; fi
  if [[ "$killed" -eq 1 ]]; then CAP_PHASE="$label"; CAP_TURN="$cap_turn"; finish cap_failure 3 "watchdog stopped $label at turn $cap_turn"; fi
  if [[ "$timed_out" == false ]] && { [[ $rc -eq 143 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 137 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 129 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 130 ]]; }; then
    finish interrupted 4 "phase $label was killed from outside (exit $rc)"
  fi
  if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]]; then
    if [[ "$timed_out" == true ]]; then finish agent_error 1 "phase $label timed out after ${tsec}s"; fi
    finish agent_error 1 "phase $label exited $rc"
  fi
  if [[ $SPENT_MICRO -ge $CAP_MICRO ]]; then
    CAP_PHASE="$label"; finish cap_failure 3 "spend USD $(jq -n --argjson s "$SPENT_MICRO" '$s/1000000') reached the cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD after $label"
  fi
  write_pipeline
}

gate_verdict() {  # gate_verdict <feedback.md> → APPROVED | CHANGES_REQUIRED | none
  local f="$1" line v
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || { echo none; return 0; }
  line="$(awk '/<!-- LOA-VERDICT \{.*\} -->[[:space:]]*$/ {l=$0} END {print l}' "$f")"
  [[ -n "$line" ]] || { echo none; return 0; }
  line="${line#*<!-- LOA-VERDICT }"; line="${line% -->*}"
  v="$(jq -r '.verdict // "none"' <<<"$line" 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
  case "$v" in APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED) echo "$v" ;; *) echo none ;; esac

record_skip() {  # record_skip <name> <label> <reason>
  jq -cn --arg name "$1" --arg label "$2" --arg why "$3" \
    '{name: $name, label: $label, skipped: true, reason: $why, session_id: null, exit: null, cost_usd: 0}' >> "$PHASES_FILE"
}

PLAN_NAMES=() PLAN_LABELS=()
while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
  PLAN_NAMES+=("$name"); PLAN_LABELS+=("$label")
done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$PLAN_JSON")
[[ ${#PLAN_NAMES[@]} -gt 0 ]] || infra "the phase plan is empty"
for name in "${PLAN_NAMES[@]}"; do
  [[ -f "$PROMPTS_DIR/$name.md" ]] || infra "no phase prompt for $name"
done

write_pipeline
i=0
while [[ $i -lt ${#PLAN_NAMES[@]} ]]; do
  name="${PLAN_NAMES[$i]}" label="${PLAN_LABELS[$i]}"
  i=$((i + 1))
  [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]] && finish interrupted 4 "driver received a signal before $label"
  if [[ "$name" == FIX && "$LAST_VERDICT" != CHANGES_REQUIRED ]]; then
    record_skip "$name" "$label" "preceding gate verdict $LAST_VERDICT"
    continue
  fi
  run_phase "$name" "$label"
done

finish completed 0

#
# Tested by evals/tests/execute-agent.bats and evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
# eval.yml trust boundary: a literal in-tree path, no variable on the source line
pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR" >/dev/null
# shellcheck source=lib/sandbox-mount.sh
source ./lib/sandbox-mount.sh
popd >/dev/null

TASK_YAML=""
WORKSPACE=""
RUN_ID=""
TRIAL_ID=""
TIMEOUT_S=900

usage() {
  sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,95p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2
  exit 2
}

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --task-yaml) TASK_YAML="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --workspace) WORKSPACE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --run-id) RUN_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --trial-id) TRIAL_ID="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --timeout) TIMEOUT_S="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --help|-h) usage ;;
    *) echo "ERROR: Unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" && -n "$WORKSPACE" ]] || { echo "ERROR: --task-yaml and --workspace are required" >&2; exit 2; }
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || { echo "ERROR: task YAML not found: $TASK_YAML" >&2; exit 2; }

WORKSPACE="$(cd "$WORKSPACE" && pwd)"

skill="$(yq -r '.agent.skill // ""' "$TASK_YAML")"
if [[ -z "$skill" || "$skill" == "null" ]]; then
  echo "execute-agent: task declares no .agent.skill — nothing to run" >&2
  exit 3
fi
case "$skill" in
  */*|.*|'') echo "ERROR: invalid skill name '$skill'" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

PROMPT_TREE="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$REPO_ROOT}"
PROMPT_TREE="$(cd "$PROMPT_TREE" && pwd)"
CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
MODEL="${EVAL_MODEL:-claude-sonnet-5}"
MAX_TURNS="${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}"

skill_src="$PROMPT_TREE/.claude/skills/$skill"
[[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { echo "ERROR: prompt tree $PROMPT_TREE has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v "$CLAUDE_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$CLAUDE_BIN" ]] || { echo "ERROR: CLI not found: $CLAUDE_BIN (set EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN)" >&2; exit 2; }

# --- 2. materialize ----------------------------------------------------------
# The materialisation and toggle functions live in lib/sandbox-mount.sh (cycle-130
# Task 1.6, shared with pipeline-run.sh); the arm is resolved first because
# loa_mount: false skips the prompt surface entirely.
eval_dir="$WORKSPACE/.eval"
mkdir -p "$eval_dir"

# --- 2b. control arm (cycle-129 FR-2) -----------------------------------------
ARM_MODE=false
[[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" ]] && ARM_MODE=true
ARM="${LOA_EVAL_ARM:-baseline}"
[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { echo "ERROR: invalid LOA_EVAL_ARM '$ARM'" >&2; exit 2; }

# The arm's toggles: explicit JSON, else the suite's arms[] / ab.arms[] entry.
resolve_toggles() {
  # audit r1 DISS-C-001: toggles exist only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set); a stale

      || { echo "ERROR: LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES is not a JSON object" >&2; return 2; }

argv=(
  "$CLAUDE_BIN" -p "$prompt"
  --output-format stream-json --verbose
  --model "$MODEL"
  --restricted --tools "Read,Grep,Glob,Write"

argv+=(--max-turns "$MAX_TURNS")
[[ -n "$effort" ]] && argv+=(--effort "$effort")

stderr_log="$eval_dir/agent-stderr.log"
start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
rc=0
(

  export LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH="$eval_dir/model-invoke.jsonl"
  export LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH="$eval_dir/cost-ledger.jsonl"
  export EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL"
  # sprint-237 audit HIGH-001: the CLI keeps HOME (its own credentials live there)
  # and PATH (its toolchain); the operator's other credentials are not the agent
  # under test's business, and its temp files stay inside the sandbox.
  unset GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN OPENAI_API_KEY AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN

  # that session's coupling (child-session flag, session id, messaging socket,
  # agent teams) and its subagent model (the sprint-255 driver session carried
  # CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=opus). Decouple the session and pin every
  # auxiliary model to the executor model. (A safeguard-refusal fallback to
  # another model is a separate CLI behaviour, recorded below as
  # refusal_fallbacks; no environment setting turns it off.)
  unset CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET \
    CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED
  export CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL="$MODEL"
  mkdir -p "$eval_dir/tmp" && export TMPDIR="$eval_dir/tmp"
  exec timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15 "$TIMEOUT_S" "${argv[@]}"
) > "$events" 2> "$stderr_log" || rc=$?
end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
duration_ms=$(( end_ms - start_ms ))

# --- 4. record ---------------------------------------------------------------
# The last `result` event is the CLI's summary (absent on crash/timeout).
result_json="$(grep -E '^\{.*"type" *: *"result"' "$events" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)"
if [[ -z "$result_json" ]] || ! jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$result_json"; then
  result_json='{"type":"result","subtype":"missing","is_error":true}'
fi
printf '%s\n' "$result_json" > "$eval_dir/agent-output.json"

# Ordered tool writes from the transcript (Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit).
tool_writes="$(jq -c '
  select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[]? |
  select(.type=="tool_use" and (.name=="Write" or .name=="Edit" or .name=="MultiEdit" or .name=="NotebookEdit")) |
  {tool:.name, path:(.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
' "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc 'to_entries | map({seq:(.key+1), tool:.value.tool, path:.value.path})' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
[[ -n "$tool_writes" ]] || tool_writes='[]'

# cycle-129: a safeguard refusal makes the CLI retry the session on another
# model (system/model_refusal_fallback); the arm run must see it, because the
# output after it is not the requested executor's.
refusal_fallbacks="$(jq -c 'select(.type=="system" and .subtype=="model_refusal_fallback")
  | {from: (.original_model // null), to: (.fallback_model // null), category: (.api_refusal_category // null),
     scope: (.scope // null)}' "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc '.' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
[[ -n "$refusal_fallbacks" ]] || refusal_fallbacks='[]'

is_error="$(jq -r '.is_error // false' <<<"$result_json")"
[[ $rc -ne 0 ]] && is_error=true

jq -n \
  --arg skill "$skill" \
  --arg model_requested "$MODEL" \
  --arg effort "$effort" \
  --arg prompt_tree "$PROMPT_TREE" \
  --arg prompt_tree_sha "$prompt_tree_sha" \
  --arg prompt_tree_commit "$prompt_tree_commit" \
  --argjson prompt_tree_dirty "$prompt_tree_dirty" \
  --arg run_id "$RUN_ID" \
  --arg trial_id "$TRIAL_ID" \
  --argjson rc "$rc" \
  --argjson is_error "$is_error" \
  --argjson duration_ms "$duration_ms" \
  --argjson result "$result_json" \
  --argjson tool_writes "$tool_writes" \
  --arg arm "$ARM" \
  --argjson arm_toggles "$ARM_TOGGLES" \
  --argjson arm_evidence "$ARM_EVIDENCE" \
  --arg source_commit "${LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT:-$prompt_tree_commit}" \
  --argjson refusal_fallbacks "$refusal_fallbacks" \
  '
  def norm_usage(u): {
    input_tokens: (u.input_tokens // u.inputTokens // 0),
    output_tokens: (u.output_tokens // u.outputTokens // 0),
    cache_creation_input_tokens: (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // u.cacheCreationInputTokens // 0),
    cache_read_input_tokens: (u.cache_read_input_tokens // u.cacheReadInputTokens // 0)
  };
  ($result.modelUsage // {}) as $mu |
  # the model that produced the output: the modelUsage entry with the most
  # output tokens (a haiku helper call must not be mis-attributed — the
  # framework-review 2026-09-17 rec 5 class), else the requested id.
  (if ($mu | length) > 0
     then ($mu | to_entries | max_by(.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0) | .key)
     else $model_requested end) as $model_id |
  {
    schema_version: 1,
    skill: $skill,
    run_id: $run_id,
    trial_id: $trial_id,
    model_requested: $model_requested,
    model_id: $model_id,
    effort: $effort,
    prompt_tree: $prompt_tree,
    prompt_tree_sha: $prompt_tree_sha,
    prompt_tree_commit: $prompt_tree_commit,
    prompt_tree_dirty: $prompt_tree_dirty,
    exit_code: $rc,
    is_error: $is_error,
    duration_ms: $duration_ms,
    num_turns: ($result.num_turns // 0),
    total_cost_usd: ($result.total_cost_usd // 0),
    usage: norm_usage($result.usage // {}),
    models_used: ($mu | with_entries(.value = (.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0))),
    refusal_fallbacks: $refusal_fallbacks,
    tool_writes: $tool_writes,
    arm: $arm,
    arm_toggles: $arm_toggles,
    arm_evidence: $arm_evidence,
    source_commit: $source_commit
  }' > "$eval_dir/executor.json"

if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]]; then
  echo "execute-agent: CLI exited $rc (see $stderr_log)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/took-effect.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.8 (SDD D-4.2, §5.10; AC-1.8)
#
# evals/harness/took-effect.sh evaluates each arm's `took_effect` rule ids against
# a run directory's artefacts. Every rule gets a passing case (the arm's own fixture
# run) and a failing case (another arm's run judged under this arm, or a mutated
# copy). Fixtures: evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/ (regen.sh rebuilds them).
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  TE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/took-effect.sh"
  FX="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-runs"
  SUITE="$FX/suite.yaml"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/te.XXXXXX")"
  cp -a "$FX/runs" "$T/runs"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

te() {  # te <run> [--arm ID] [--json]
  local run="$1"; shift
  run "$TE" --run-dir "$T/runs/$run" --suite-file "$SUITE" "$@"
}
line() { printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -E "^arm [a-z0-9_]+: $1 " ; }   # the rule's line
edit_json() { jq "$2" "$1" > "$T/x.json" && mv "$T/x.json" "$1"; }

@test "every fixture run passes its own arm's rules (exit 0, final OK line)" {
  local r
  for r in a0-build a1-build a1-review a2-build a3-review a4-build a5-build a6-build a7-build refused-a4-review; do
    te "$r"
    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$r: $output"; return 1; }
    [[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | sed -n '$p')" =~ ^arm\ [a-z0-9_]+:\ OK$ ]]
  done
}

@test "no_dot_claude: OK on A0; FAIL when the sandbox has CLAUDE.md" {
  te a0-build
  line no_dot_claude | grep -q ' OK '
  echo x > "$T/runs/a0-build/sandbox/CLAUDE.md"
  te a0-build
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  line no_dot_claude | grep -q ' FAIL '
  [[ "$output" == *"arm a0_bare: FAIL (1 of 4 rules)"* ]]
}

@test "no_system_prompt: OK on A0; FAIL when an argv carries --append-system-prompt-file" {
  te a0-build
  line no_system_prompt | grep -q ' OK no --append-system-prompt-file in 1 argv'
  edit_json "$T/runs/a0-build/meta/phase-BARE.argv.json" '.argv += ["--append-system-prompt-file", "x.md"]'
  te a0-build
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  line no_system_prompt | grep -q ' FAIL --append-system-prompt-file in phase-BARE.argv.json'
}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.4, AC-1.3)
     4	#
     5	# Proves that a FRESH downstream submodule mount of this repository passes
     6	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
     7	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
     8	#
     9	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
    10	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
    11	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
    12	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
    13	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
    14	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
    15	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
    16	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
    17	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
    18	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
    19	#                    submodule from there; no network).
    20	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
    21	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
    22	#      is printed, then a summary line
    23	#        fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=T Missing=M not-mounted=N check-loa-rc=R
    24	#
    25	# Git runs hermetically: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1,
    26	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
    27	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
    28	#
    29	# Usage:
    30	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
    31	#
    32	# Options:
    33	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
    34	#                repository the script lives in)
    35	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
    36	#                (use before the change is committed)
    37	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
    38	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
    39	#                /tmp)
    40	#   -h, --help   this text
    41	#
    42	# Exit codes:
    43	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
    44	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
    45	#   2    usage error
    46	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
    47	#        the failing step's output is printed
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    53	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
    55	
    56	REF=""
    57	KEEP=0
    58	WORKTREE=0
    59	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --ref)
    63	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
    64	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    65	    --tmp)
    66	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
    67	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    68	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
    69	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
    70	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    71	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    72	  esac
    73	done
    74	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
    75	
    76	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
    77	SRC="$(git -C "$SELF_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "script is not inside a git work tree"
    78	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
    79	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
    80	
    81	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
    82	cleanup() {
    83	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
    84	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
    85	  else
    86	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    87	  fi
    88	}
    89	trap cleanup EXIT
    90	
    91	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
    92	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
    93	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
    94	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
    95	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
    96	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
    97	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
    98	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
    99	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   100	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   101	
   102	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   103	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   104	  local desc="$1"; shift
   105	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   106	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   107	    die3 "$desc"
   108	  fi
   109	}
   110	
   111	suffix=""
   112	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"
   113	echo "fresh-mount-proof: source $SRC at ${REF_SHA}${suffix}"
   114	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   115	
   116	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
   117	UP="$WORK/upstream"
   118	run_step "clone $SRC" git clone --quiet --no-checkout "file://$SRC" "$UP"
   119	run_step "fetch $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" fetch --quiet origin "$REF_SHA"
   120	run_step "branch at $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" checkout --quiet -B fresh-mount-proof "$REF_SHA"
   121	
   122	overlay() {
   123	  local p
   124	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   125	    if [[ -e "$SRC/$p" || -L "$SRC/$p" ]]; then
   126	      [[ -d "$SRC/$p" && ! -L "$SRC/$p" ]] && continue   # gitlink / nested repo
   127	      mkdir -p "$UP/$(dirname "$p")"
   128	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   129	      cp -P "$SRC/$p" "$UP/$p"
   130	    else
   131	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   132	    fi
   133	  done < <(git -C "$SRC" ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard)
   134	  git -C "$UP" add -A
   135	  git -C "$UP" commit --quiet --allow-empty -m "fresh-mount-proof: work-tree state of $SRC"
   136	}
   137	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && run_step "work-tree overlay" overlay
   138	MOUNT_SHA="$(git -C "$UP" rev-parse HEAD)"
   139	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mounting upstream commit $MOUNT_SHA"
   140	
   141	# --- 2. downstream repository and the submodule mount --------------------------
   142	DOWN="$WORK/downstream"
   143	mkdir -p "$DOWN"
   144	init_downstream() {
   145	  git -C "$DOWN" init --quiet
   146	  printf '# downstream fixture\n' > "$DOWN/README.md"
   147	  git -C "$DOWN" add README.md
   148	  git -C "$DOWN" commit --quiet -m "initial commit"
   149	}
   150	run_step "downstream init" init_downstream
   151	
   152	do_mount() {
   153	  (cd "$DOWN" && LOA_UPSTREAM="file://$UP" bash "$UP/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh" \
   154	    --branch fresh-mount-proof --ref "$MOUNT_SHA" --force < /dev/null)
   155	}
   156	run_step "mount-submodule.sh" do_mount
   157	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mount-submodule.sh exited 0 ($(grep -c 'Linked' "$LOG" || true) link lines)"
   158	
   159	# --- 3. Aleph off ---------------------------------------------------------------

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
#
# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
#
# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
#
#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →

[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0

_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }

# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
# hashes the corpus the same way.
_sm_sha256() {
  python3 -I -c '
import hashlib, sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(b)
    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
}

# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
_sm_evidence() {
  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
  else
    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
  fi
}

# message text goes through %s verbatim (backslash-/dash-safe).
log()  { printf '%b[loa-submodule]%b %s\n' "$GREEN" "$NC" "$*"; }
warn() { printf '%b[loa-submodule]%b WARNING: %s\n' "$YELLOW" "$NC" "$*"; }
err()  { printf '%b[loa-submodule]%b ERROR: %s\n' "$RED" "$NC" "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
info() { printf '%b[loa-submodule]%b %s\n' "$CYAN" "$NC" "$*"; }
step() { printf '%b[loa-submodule]%b -> %s\n' "$BLUE" "$NC" "$*"; }

# === Configuration ===
LOA_REMOTE_URL="${LOA_UPSTREAM:-https://github.com/0xHoneyJar/loa.git}"
LOA_BRANCH="main"
LOA_TAG=""
LOA_REF=""
SUBMODULE_PATH=".loa"
VERSION_FILE=".loa-version.json"
CONFIG_FILE=".loa.config.yaml"
FORCE_MODE=false
NO_COMMIT=false
CHECK_SYMLINKS=false
RECONCILE_SYMLINKS=false
SOURCE_ONLY=false

# === Argument Parsing ===
# Guard for option-taking flags: a missing operand must fail loudly instead of
# silently consuming the next flag (or an empty string) as the value (#1162).
require_operand() {
  if [[ -z "${2:-}" || "${2:-}" == -* ]]; then
    err "Option $1 requires a value (got '${2:-}')"
  fi
}

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case $1 in
    --branch)
      require_operand "$1" "${2:-}"
      LOA_BRANCH="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --tag)
      require_operand "$1" "${2:-}"
      LOA_TAG="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --ref)
      require_operand "$1" "${2:-}"
      LOA_REF="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --force|-f)
      FORCE_MODE=true
      shift
      ;;
    --no-commit)
      NO_COMMIT=true
      shift
      ;;
    --check-symlinks)
      CHECK_SYMLINKS=true
      shift
      ;;
    --reconcile)
      RECONCILE_SYMLINKS=true
      shift
      ;;
    --source-only)
      # Allow sourcing this script for its functions without running main
      SOURCE_ONLY=true
      shift

    -h|--help)
      echo "Usage: mount-submodule.sh [OPTIONS]"
      echo ""
      echo "Install Loa as a git submodule with symlinks."
      echo ""
      echo "Options:"
      echo "  --branch <name>   Loa branch to use (default: main)"
      echo "  --tag <tag>       Loa tag to pin to (e.g., v1.15.0)"
      echo "  --ref <ref>       Loa ref to pin to (commit, branch, or tag)"
      echo "  --force, -f       Force remount without prompting"
      echo "  --no-commit       Skip creating git commit after mount"
      echo "  --check-symlinks  Check symlink health (no changes)"
      echo "  --reconcile       Check and fix symlink health"
      echo "  -h, --help        Show this help message"
      echo ""
      echo "Examples:"
      echo "  mount-submodule.sh                    # Latest main"
      echo "  mount-submodule.sh --tag v1.15.0      # Specific tag"
      echo "  mount-submodule.sh --branch feature/x # Specific branch"
      echo ""
      exit 0
      ;;
    *)

# =============================================================================
# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
#
# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
#
# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
# task_types against the known types).
#
# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
# =============================================================================
name: ablation-2.0
version: 1
source_commit: "<sprint-258-commit>"   # the lead sets the Sprint 258 commit (rc.5 plus the mount fix; F2, DEC-0392)
agy_opt_in: false
tasks:
  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
suite_version: 1
trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250}   # reserve released to A7 when the re-verification rule needs no run (DEC-0398)
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}
  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

arms:
  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a8_no_ceremonies, label: A8, absent: true,
     evidence: "no /meeting command, skill or sosyete config key at 4d69c3c4 (grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/; ls .claude/commands .claude/skills)"}

rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
  threshold_points: 0.03
  cost_lower_pct: 15
  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)
  predicates:                                # DEC-0416; d = arm − A1 point estimate, [lo, hi] its 90 % interval, c/w = cost/wall-clock Δ %
    investigate: "any applicable primary has lo > 0"
    keep: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03 and hi < 0"
    inconclusive: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03, or the arm's excluded share > 0.25, or no valid pair"
