#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
#
# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
#
# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
#
#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
#
# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
#
# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
#
# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
# =============================================================================

[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0
_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED=true

_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }

# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
# hashes the corpus the same way.
_sm_sha256() {
  python3 -I -c '
import hashlib, sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(b)
    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
}

# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
_sm_evidence() {
  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
  else
    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mount_prompt_surface() {
  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
    return 0
  fi
  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"

_sm_sha256() {
  python3 -I -c '
import hashlib, sys

    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):

    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
}

28	# Screen (bd-j4lwr): --screen runs one trial of the first N fixtures (default
29	#   2) per arm into <results-dir>/<suite>/screen-<UTC ts>/ (its own MANIFEST,
30	#   STATUS, rows), prints a per-arm table (trials, mean USD, mean recall) on
31	#   stdout, and never writes the suite-level STATUS.json; the suite aggregate
32	#   never reads screen-* batches. --batch and --trials are ignored under --screen.
33	#
34	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
35	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
36	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
37	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
38	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
39	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
40	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
41	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
42	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
43	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
44	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
45	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
46	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
47	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
48	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
49	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
50	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
#
# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
#
# Usage:
#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
#
#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
#
# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
#
# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
RUNS=()

usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --runs)
      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
      shift
      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    --help|-h) usage ;;
    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
  esac
done
[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"

SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
  local v
  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
  v="$(yq -r "$1 // \"\"" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  num_ok "$v" && printf '%s' "$v"
  return 0
}
if [[ -z "$CAP" ]]; then
  CAP="$(yq_num '.evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml")"
  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP="$(yq_num '.caps.cycle_usd' "$SUITE")"
  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP=1500
fi
if [[ -z "$RESERVE" ]]; then
  RESERVE="$(yq_num '.caps.reserve_usd' "$SUITE")"
  [[ -n "$RESERVE" ]] || RESERVE=250
fi
num_ok "$CAP" || die "--cap must be a non-negative number"
num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"

# Explicit files must be readable; defaults are optional (absent = zero).
if [[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
  [[ -e "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl" ]] && RUNS+=("$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl")
  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl; do [[ -e "$f" ]] && RUNS+=("$f"); done
fi
EXPLICIT_LEDGER=true
if [[ -z "$LEDGER" ]]; then
  EXPLICIT_LEDGER=false
  LEDGER="$REPO_ROOT/.run/cost-ledger.jsonl"
fi
for f in ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"}; do
  [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || { echo "spend: run-row file unreadable: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
done
if [[ -e "$LEDGER" || "$EXPLICIT_LEDGER" == "true" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$LEDGER" && -r "$LEDGER" ]] || { echo "spend: ledger unreadable: $LEDGER" >&2; exit 1; }
else
  LEDGER=""
fi

python3 -I - "$SINCE" "$CAP" "$RESERVE" "$JSON" "$LEDGER" ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"} <<'PY'
import json, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

since_s, cap, reserve, as_json, ledger = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "true", sys.argv[5]
runs_files = sys.argv[6:]

def ts(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if len(s) == 10:
        s += "T00:00:00Z"
    d = datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return d if d.tzinfo else d.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

since = ts(since_s)
skipped = 0
runs_usd, runs_rows, dedup = 0.0, 0, 0
seen = set()
for f in runs_files:
    for line in open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
            c = float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0)
        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
            skipped += 1
            continue
        rid = r.get("run_id")
        key = rid if isinstance(rid, str) and rid else None
        if key is not None and key in seen:
            dedup += 1
            continue
        if key is not None:
            seen.add(key)
        runs_usd += c
        runs_rows += 1

ledger_usd, ledger_rows = 0.0, 0
if ledger:
    for line in open(ledger, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
            if ts(str(r["ts"])) < since:
                continue
            ledger_usd += float(r.get("cost_micro_usd") or 0) / 1e6
            ledger_rows += 1
        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
            skipped += 1

total = runs_usd + ledger_usd
headroom = cap - total
if skipped:
    print(f"spend: skipped {skipped} malformed line(s)", file=sys.stderr)
def n(x):
    x = round(x, 4)
    return int(x) if x == int(x) else x
if as_json:
    print(json.dumps({
        "total_usd": n(total), "runs_usd": n(runs_usd), "ledger_usd": n(ledger_usd),
        "since": since_s, "cap_usd": n(cap), "headroom_usd": n(headroom), "reserve_usd": n(reserve),
        "runs_files": runs_files, "ledger_file": ledger or None, "runs_rows": runs_rows,
        "runs_rows_deduped": dedup, "ledger_rows": ledger_rows, "skipped_lines": skipped}, sort_keys=True))
else:
    def money(x): return f"{x:,.2f}"
    def whole(x): return f"{x:,.0f}" if x == int(x) else f"{x:,.2f}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
#
# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
#
# Usage:
#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
#
#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
#
# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
#
# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
RUNS=()

usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --runs)
      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
      shift
      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    --help|-h) usage ;;
    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
  esac
done
[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"

SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
  local v
  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
  v="$(yq -r "$1 // \"\"" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  num_ok "$v" && printf '%s' "$v"
  return 0
}
if [[ -z "$CAP" ]]; then
  CAP="$(yq_num '.evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml")"
  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP="$(yq_num '.caps.cycle_usd' "$SUITE")"
  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP=1500
fi
if [[ -z "$RESERVE" ]]; then
  RESERVE="$(yq_num '.caps.reserve_usd' "$SUITE")"
  [[ -n "$RESERVE" ]] || RESERVE=250
fi
num_ok "$CAP" || die "--cap must be a non-negative number"
num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"

# Explicit files must be readable; defaults are optional (absent = zero).
if [[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
  [[ -e "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl" ]] && RUNS+=("$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl")
  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl; do [[ -e "$f" ]] && RUNS+=("$f"); done
fi
EXPLICIT_LEDGER=true
if [[ -z "$LEDGER" ]]; then
  EXPLICIT_LEDGER=false
  LEDGER="$REPO_ROOT/.run/cost-ledger.jsonl"
fi
for f in ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"}; do
  [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || { echo "spend: run-row file unreadable: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
done
if [[ -e "$LEDGER" || "$EXPLICIT_LEDGER" == "true" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$LEDGER" && -r "$LEDGER" ]] || { echo "spend: ledger unreadable: $LEDGER" >&2; exit 1; }
else
  LEDGER=""
fi

python3 -I - "$SINCE" "$CAP" "$RESERVE" "$JSON" "$LEDGER" ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"} <<'PY'
import json, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

since_s, cap, reserve, as_json, ledger = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "true", sys.argv[5]
runs_files = sys.argv[6:]

def ts(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if len(s) == 10:
        s += "T00:00:00Z"
    d = datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return d if d.tzinfo else d.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

since = ts(since_s)
skipped = 0
runs_usd, runs_rows, dedup = 0.0, 0, 0
seen = set()
for f in runs_files:
    for line in open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
            c = float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0)
        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
            skipped += 1
            continue
        rid = r.get("run_id")
        key = rid if isinstance(rid, str) and rid else None
        if key is not None and key in seen:
            dedup += 1
            continue
        if key is not None:
            seen.add(key)
        runs_usd += c
        runs_rows += 1

ledger_usd, ledger_rows = 0.0, 0
if ledger:
    for line in open(ledger, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
            if ts(str(r["ts"])) < since:
                continue
            ledger_usd += float(r.get("cost_micro_usd") or 0) / 1e6
            ledger_rows += 1
        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
            skipped += 1

total = runs_usd + ledger_usd
headroom = cap - total
if skipped:
    print(f"spend: skipped {skipped} malformed line(s)", file=sys.stderr)
def n(x):
    x = round(x, 4)
    return int(x) if x == int(x) else x
if as_json:
    print(json.dumps({
        "total_usd": n(total), "runs_usd": n(runs_usd), "ledger_usd": n(ledger_usd),
        "since": since_s, "cap_usd": n(cap), "headroom_usd": n(headroom), "reserve_usd": n(reserve),
        "runs_files": runs_files, "ledger_file": ledger or None, "runs_rows": runs_rows,
        "runs_rows_deduped": dedup, "ledger_rows": ledger_rows, "skipped_lines": skipped}, sort_keys=True))
else:
    def money(x): return f"{x:,.2f}"
    def whole(x): return f"{x:,.0f}" if x == int(x) else f"{x:,.2f}"
    print(f"cycle spend USD {money(total)} (runs {money(runs_usd)} + ledger {money(ledger_usd)} since {since_s}); "
          f"cap {whole(cap)}; headroom {money(headroom)}; reserve {whole(reserve)}")
PY

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/check-loa-mount-scope.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1 #1267,
     5	# AC-1.2/AC-1.3; SDD §5.3). check-loa.sh check_integrity classifies every
     6	# manifest path as ok, Tampered (fail), not-mounted (a submodule mount does
     7	# not link it but .loa/<path> has it: counted, one summary line, never a
     8	# failure) or Missing (fail).
     9	#
    10	# Seam: check-loa.sh already guards `main` behind
    11	#   [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]
    12	# so each case sources the script in a child bash inside the fixture
    13	# directory and calls check_integrity alone; the child exits 1 when the
    14	# FAILURES counter is non-zero, the same rule main applies. No other check
    15	# runs, and the script is not modified for the test.
    16	# =============================================================================
    17	
    18	setup() {
    19	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    20	  CHECK="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh"
    21	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cloams.XXXXXX")"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
#
# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
#
# Rules:
#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
#                              each other and from every implementer session id
#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
#                              are not frontmatter)
#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
#                              "no mount"
#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
#
# Usage:
#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
#
# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  every rule OK
#   1  any rule FAIL
#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
#
# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
# "Validate grader trust boundary").

RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================

# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)

# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
#

#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file

#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
#                              each other and from every implementer session id
#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
#                              are not frontmatter)
#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value

#                              "no mount"
#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes

#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]

# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).

#   0  every rule OK
#   1  any rule FAIL
#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)

# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
# =============================================================================

EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
}
rule_no_audit_rows() {
  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
}
rule_all_phases_present() {
  local want got st
  want="$(expected_labels)"
  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
  case "$st" in
    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
  esac
  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1
}
rule_no_plan_phase() {
  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n PLAN record(s)"; return 1; }
  EVID="no PLAN record"
}
rule_one_voice_planned() {
  local g f v bad="" ev=""
  for g in review audit; do
    f="$(envelope "$g")"
    if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then bad="$bad $g:missing"; continue; fi
    v="$(jq -r 'if (.metadata.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .metadata.companion_voice.planned
                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"
    [[ "$v" == false ]] || bad="$bad $g:planned=$v"
  done
  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="companion_voice${bad}"; return 1; }
  EVID="companion_voice${ev}"
}
rule_no_gate_phases() {
  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  [[ -z "$got" ]] || { EVID="gate records $got"; return 1; }
  EVID="no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record"
}
rule_enforce_env_false() {
  local f n=0 bad=""
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    [[ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE // "unset"' "$f")" == false ]] || bad="$bad $(basename "$f" .argv.json)"
  done < <(argv_files)
  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE not false in$bad"; return 1; }
  EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false in $n/$n phase env"
}
rule_no_flatline_rows() {
  local n=0
  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"
  fi
  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }
  [[ -f "$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]] || { EVID="no flatline rows but no sandbox sprint.md"; return 1; }
  EVID="no flatline MODELINV rows; sprint.md present"
}
rule_implementer_single_session() {
  local ids n sid f bad=""
  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
  done < <(argv_files)
  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"
}
rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
  local r a impl
  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  impl="$(jq -c '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX") | .session_id | select(. != null)] | unique' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
  fi
  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"
}
rule_effort_flag_medium() {
  local f n=0 ok=0
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
  done < <(argv_files)
  [[ $n -gt 0 && $ok -eq $n ]] || { EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"; return 1; }
  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"
}
rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
  local f n=0 hit=0
  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    n=$((n + 1))
    # the YAML frontmatter only (first line `---` to the next `---`); a body line may say effort:
    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
      && hit=$((hit + 1))
  done
  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"
}
rule_integrity_clean() {
  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
  fi
  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
  out="$(python3 -I -c '
import hashlib, json, os, sys
root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
    if not os.path.isfile(p):
        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
    elif sha(p) != want:
        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
  local n bad missing filesha first
  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
  return 0
}
rule_applicability_refused() {
  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
    fi
    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
  fi
  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
  fi
  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
}

# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
  R="$1"
  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
  ARM="$arm"
  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
    rules="applicability_refused"
  else
    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
  fi
  while IFS= read -r rule; do
    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
    else
      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
    fi
    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
    else
      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
    fi
  done <<<"$rules"
  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then

     3	# cycle-130 bats (run-arms.bats, arm-toggles.bats). No model call.
     4	#
     5	#   STUB_COST_USD      the result event's total_cost_usd (default: the base stub's

     7	#   STUB_FULL_ENV_FILE the complete environment (`env`) is written there
     8	#   STUB_CONC_DIR      concurrency probe: each call registers itself in the dir
     9	#                      for STUB_SLEEP seconds and appends the number of calls
    10	#                      running at its start to <dir>.log
    11	#   STUB_SLEEP         seconds to stay registered (default 0)
    12	set -euo pipefail
    13	HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    14	BASE="$HERE/../claude-stub.sh"
    15	if [[ "${1:-}" == "--version" ]]; then exec "$BASE" --version; fi
    16	
    17	if [[ -n "${STUB_FULL_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then env > "$STUB_FULL_ENV_FILE"; fi
    18	if [[ -n "${STUB_CONC_DIR:-}" ]]; then
    19	  mkdir -p "$STUB_CONC_DIR"
    20	  : > "$STUB_CONC_DIR/$$"

write_pipeline() {  # write_pipeline — (re)write meta/pipeline.json from the current state
  local phases ev finished
  phases="$(jq -sc '.' "$PHASES_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
  ev="$(evidence_json 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')"
  finished=null
  [[ "$STATUS" != running ]] && finished="\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""
  jq -n \
    --arg run_id "$RUN_ID" --arg arm "$ARM" --arg task_id "$TASK_ID" --arg task_type "$TASK_TYPE" \
    --argjson trial "$TRIAL" --arg source_commit "$SOURCE_COMMIT" --argjson suite_version "$SUITE_VERSION" \
    --argjson phases "$phases" --arg status "$STATUS" --arg cap_phase "$CAP_PHASE" --argjson cap_turn "$CAP_TURN" \
    --arg reason "$REASON" --argjson arm_evidence "$ev" --argjson toggles "$TOGGLES" --arg executor "$EXECUTOR" \
    --arg image_digest "$IMAGE_DIGEST" --arg fingerprint "$FINGERPRINT" --arg tools "$TOOLS" \
    --argjson snapshots "$SNAPSHOTS_JSON" --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" \
    --argjson spent "$SPENT_MICRO" --arg cap "$MAX_RUN_USD" --arg effort "$EFFORT_FLAG" '
    {schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, arm: $arm, task_id: $task_id, task_type: $task_type, trial: $trial,
     source_commit: $source_commit, suite_version: $suite_version, status: $status,
     cap_phase: (if $cap_phase == "" then null else $cap_phase end), cap_turn: $cap_turn,
     reason: (if $reason == "" then null else $reason end),
     max_run_usd: ($cap | tonumber), spent_usd: ($spent / 1000000),
     arm_toggles: $toggles, effort_flag: (if $effort == "" then null else $effort end), arm_evidence: $arm_evidence,
     executor_mode: $executor, image_digest: (if $image_digest == "" then null else $image_digest end),
     fingerprint: (if $fingerprint == "" then null else $fingerprint end), sandbox_fingerprint: (if $fingerprint == "" then null else $fingerprint end),
     tools: $tools, snapshots: $snapshots, phases: $phases, started: $started, finished: $finished}' \
    > "$META/pipeline.json.tmp" && mv "$META/pipeline.json.tmp" "$META/pipeline.json"
}

finish() {  # finish <status> <exit> [reason]
  STATUS="$1"; [[ -n "${3:-}" ]] && REASON="$3"
=====PHASE RECORD
  CUR_PID="" CUR_CONTAINER=""
  [[ "$prices" != null ]] && est="$(price_events "$events" "$prices" "$budget")"

  # --- record ---
  local result init_sid sid ledger_rows ledger_micro rf timed_out=false elapsed_ms
  elapsed_ms=$(( end_s - start_s ))
  result="$(grep -E '^\{.*"type" *: *"result"' "$events" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '$p' || true)"
  if [[ -z "$result" ]] || ! jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$result"; then
    result='{"type":"result","subtype":"missing","is_error":true}'
  fi
  init_sid="$(jq -R -r 'fromjson? | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init") | .session_id // empty' "$events" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
  sid="${init_sid:-$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' <<<"$result")}"
  if [[ "$SINGLE_SESSION" == true && -z "$IMPL_SESSION" && -n "$sid" ]]; then
    case "$name" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) IMPL_SESSION="$sid" ;; esac
  fi
  rf="$(jq -R -c 'fromjson? | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "model_refusal_fallback")
        | {from: (.original_model // null), to: (.fallback_model // null), category: (.api_refusal_category // null), scope: (.scope // null)}' \
        "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc '.' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
  [[ -n "$rf" ]] || rf='[]'
  ledger_rows="$(sed -n "$((ledger_before + 1)),\$p" "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  ledger_micro="$(printf '%s\n' "$ledger_rows" | jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
        | (.cost_micro_usd // ((.cost_usd // 0) * 1000000))] | add // 0 | round' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  minv_after="$(wc -l < "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl" | tr -d ' ')"
  cp "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl" "$EVALD/model-invoke.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
  cp "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl" "$EVALD/cost-ledger.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true
  local env_f
  for env_f in "$WS"/grimoires/loa/a2a/"$SPRINT"/adversarial-*.json; do
    [[ -f "$env_f" ]] && cp "$env_f" "$EVALD/"
  done
  if [[ $rc -eq 124 ]] || { [[ $rc -eq 137 ]] && [[ $elapsed_ms -ge $(( tsec * 1000 )) ]]; }; then timed_out=true; fi

  local snap="" verdict=null skill effort_req
  if [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 0 ]] && { [[ "$name" == IMPLEMENT ]] || [[ "$name" == FIX ]]; }; then
    sgit add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sgit commit -q --allow-empty -m "snapshot $label" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    snap="$(sgit rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "$snap" ]]; then
      sgit bundle create "$SNAPS/$label.bundle" HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      SNAPSHOTS_JSON="$(jq -c --arg k "$(printf '%s' "$label" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" --arg v "$snap" '.[$k] = $v' <<<"$SNAPSHOTS_JSON")"
      jq -n --argjson s "$SNAPSHOTS_JSON" --arg base "$BASE_COMMIT" '$s + {base: $base}' > "$SNAPS/index.json"
    fi
  fi
  case "$name" in
    REVIEW) verdict="$(gate_verdict "$WS/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT/engineer-feedback.md")" ;;
    AUDIT)  verdict="$(gate_verdict "$WS/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT/auditor-sprint-feedback.md")" ;;
  esac
  if [[ "$name" == REVIEW || "$name" == AUDIT ]]; then LAST_VERDICT="$verdict"; fi
  # Sprint 258 smoke (lead, DEC-0490): a gate that exhausted --max-turns AFTER writing its LOA-VERDICT
  # trailer has delivered its result; the extra turns were housekeeping. Count the phase as completed
  # with turn_cap_hit=true and keep the CLI's exit in cli_exit. Any other phase keeps the error.
  local subtype turn_cap_hit=false gate_recovered=false cli_exit="$rc"
  subtype="$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' <<<"$result")"
  [[ "$subtype" == error_max_turns ]] && turn_cap_hit=true
  if [[ "$turn_cap_hit" == true && $rc -ne 0 && "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 0 ]] && { [[ "$name" == REVIEW ]] || [[ "$name" == AUDIT ]]; } \
     && [[ -n "$verdict" && "$verdict" != none && "$verdict" != null ]]; then
    gate_recovered=true; rc=0
  fi
  skill="$(phase_skill "$name")"
  effort_req="$EFFORT_FLAG"
  if [[ -z "$effort_req" && -n "$skill" && -f "$WS/.claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md" ]]; then
    effort_req="$(awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---"{exit} NR>1 && $0=="---"{exit} NR>1 && /^effort:/{sub(/^effort:[[:space:]]*/,""); gsub(/["'\'' ]/,""); print; exit}' \
      "$WS/.claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md")"
  fi

  local est_turns est_micro
  est_turns="$(printf '%s' "$est" | awk '{print $1}')"; est_micro="$(printf '%s' "$est" | awk '{print $2}')"
  jq -cn --arg name "$name" --arg label "$label" --arg sid "$sid" --arg model "$model" --arg effort "$effort_req" \
    --argjson result "$result" --argjson rf "$rf" --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson dur "$elapsed_ms" \
    --arg snap "$snap" --arg verdict "$verdict" --arg resume "$resume" --arg started "$started_iso" \
    --arg finished "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson ledger "$ledger_micro" --argjson timed_out "$timed_out" \
    --argjson killed "$killed" --argjson cap_turn "$cap_turn" --argjson est_turns "${est_turns:-0}" \
    --argjson est_micro "${est_micro:-0}" --argjson turns "$turns" --argjson tsec "$tsec" --arg priced "$prices" \
    --argjson minv_from "$((minv_before + 1))" --argjson minv_to "$minv_after" \
    --argjson ledger_from "$((ledger_before + 1))" --argjson turn_cap_hit "$turn_cap_hit" \
    --argjson gate_recovered "$gate_recovered" --argjson cli_exit "$cli_exit" '
    def u(k1; k2): ($result.usage[k1] // $result.usage[k2] // 0);
    {name: $name, label: $label, skipped: false,
     session_id: (if $sid == "" then null else $sid end),
     resumed_from: (if $resume == "" then null else $resume end),
     model_requested: $model,
     models_used: (($result.modelUsage // {}) | with_entries(.value = (.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0))),
     effort_requested: (if $effort == "" then null else $effort end),
     tokens_in: u("input_tokens"; "inputTokens"), tokens_out: u("output_tokens"; "outputTokens"),
     cache_read_tokens: u("cache_read_input_tokens"; "cacheReadInputTokens"),
     cache_creation_tokens: u("cache_creation_input_tokens"; "cacheCreationInputTokens"),
     cost_usd: ($result.total_cost_usd // ($est_micro / 1000000)),
     cost_source: (if $result.total_cost_usd != null then "result" else "watchdog_estimate" end),
     ledger_cost_usd: ($ledger / 1000000),
     duration_ms: ($result.duration_ms // $dur), wall_ms: $dur,
     num_turns: ($result.num_turns // $est_turns), max_turns: $turns, timeout_s: $tsec,
     exit: $rc, cli_exit: $cli_exit, timed_out: $timed_out, is_error: (($result.is_error // false) or ($rc != 0)),
     result_subtype: ($result.subtype // null), turn_cap_hit: $turn_cap_hit, gate_recovered: $gate_recovered,
     refusal_fallbacks: $rf,
     modelinv_lines: {from: $minv_from, to: $minv_to},
     ledger_lines_from: $ledger_from,
     snapshot: (if $snap == "" then null else $snap end),
     verdict: (if $verdict == "null" or $verdict == "" then null else $verdict end),
     watchdog: {priced: ($priced != "null"), estimate_usd: ($est_micro / 1000000), turns_seen: $est_turns,
                killed: ($killed == 1), cap_turn: (if $killed == 1 then $cap_turn else null end)},
     started: $started, finished: $finished}' >> "$PHASES_FILE"

  # --- account and decide ---
  local cost_micro
  cost_micro="$(jq -r --argjson e "${est_micro:-0}" '(.total_cost_usd // ($e / 1000000)) * 1000000 | round' <<<"$result")"
  SPENT_MICRO=$(( SPENT_MICRO + cost_micro + ledger_micro ))
  if [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]]; then finish interrupted 4 "driver received a signal during $label"; fi
  if [[ "$killed" -eq 1 ]]; then CAP_PHASE="$label"; CAP_TURN="$cap_turn"; finish cap_failure 3 "watchdog stopped $label at turn $cap_turn"; fi
  if [[ "$timed_out" == false ]] && { [[ $rc -eq 143 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 137 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 129 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 130 ]]; }; then
    finish interrupted 4 "phase $label was killed from outside (exit $rc)"
  fi
  if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]]; then
    if [[ "$timed_out" == true ]]; then finish agent_error 1 "phase $label timed out after ${tsec}s"; fi
    finish agent_error 1 "phase $label exited $rc"
  fi
  if [[ $SPENT_MICRO -ge $CAP_MICRO ]]; then
    CAP_PHASE="$label"; finish cap_failure 3 "spend USD $(jq -n --argjson s "$SPENT_MICRO" '$s/1000000') reached the cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD after $label"
  fi
  write_pipeline
}

gate_verdict() {  # gate_verdict <feedback.md> → APPROVED | CHANGES_REQUIRED | none
  local f="$1" line v
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || { echo none; return 0; }
  line="$(awk '/<!-- LOA-VERDICT \{.*\} -->[[:space:]]*$/ {l=$0} END {print l}' "$f")"
  [[ -n "$line" ]] || { echo none; return 0; }
  line="${line#*<!-- LOA-VERDICT }"; line="${line% -->*}"
  v="$(jq -r '.verdict // "none"' <<<"$line" 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
  case "$v" in APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED) echo "$v" ;; *) echo none ;; esac
}

record_skip() {  # record_skip <name> <label> <reason>
  jq -cn --arg name "$1" --arg label "$2" --arg why "$3" \
    '{name: $name, label: $label, skipped: true, reason: $why, session_id: null, exit: null, cost_usd: 0}' >> "$PHASES_FILE"
}

while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
+#
+# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
+#
+#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
+#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
+#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
+#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
+#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
+#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
+#
+# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
+#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
+#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
+#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
+#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
+#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
+#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
+#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
+#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
+#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
+#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
+#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
+#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
+#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
+#      bats | bash | node | npx
+#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
+#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
+#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
+#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
+#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
+#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
+#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
+#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
+#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
+#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
+#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
+#
+# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
+# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
+# =============================================================================
+set -euo pipefail
+export LC_ALL=C
+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
+SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
+PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
+SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
+
+usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,45p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
+die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
+
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --smoke) SMOKE=true; shift ;;
+    --allow-partial) ALLOW_PARTIAL=true; shift ;;
+    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --help|-h) usage ;;
+    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
+  esac
+done
+[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
+ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
+[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
+for tool in yq jq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
+# eval.yml trust boundary: a literal in-tree path, no variable on the source line
+pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR" >/dev/null
+# shellcheck source=lib/sandbox-mount.sh
+source ./lib/sandbox-mount.sh
+popd >/dev/null
+
+WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/validate-suite.XXXXXX")"
+trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
+yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE" > "$WORK/suite.json" 2>/dev/null || die "suite file is not valid YAML: $SUITE_FILE"
+
+# Collect task directories: tasks/* (counted) and smoke/* (with --smoke).
+: > "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
+for group in tasks smoke; do
+  [[ "$group" == "smoke" && "$SMOKE" != "true" ]] && continue
+  [[ -d "$ROOT/$group" ]] || continue
+  for d in "$ROOT/$group"/*/; do
+    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
+    d="${d%/}"
+    n="$(basename "$d")"
+    j="$WORK/$group.$n.json"
+    if [[ ! -f "$d/task.yaml" ]]; then
+      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "-" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"; continue
+    fi
+    if yq -o=json '.' "$d/task.yaml" > "$j" 2>/dev/null && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$j" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "$j" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
+    else
+      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "!" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
+    fi
+  done
+done
+
+# Python does the schema, counts, allowlist, manifest, leakage and suite checks;
+# it prints violations, and `FIXTURE\t<id>\t<dir>` lines for the path rule below.
+python3 -I - "$WORK/tasks.tsv" "$WORK/suite.json" "$ROOT" "$REPO_ROOT" "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" "$PROMPTS_DIR" > "$WORK/out.txt" <<'PY' || { cat "$WORK/out.txt" >&2 2>/dev/null; die "validator crashed"; }
+import json, os, re, sys
+
+tasks_tsv, suite_json, root, repo, allow_partial, prompts_dir = sys.argv[1:7]
+allow_partial = allow_partial == "true"
+suite = json.load(open(suite_json))
+out = []
+def bad(tid, msg): out.append(f"{tid}: {msg}")
+
+TYPES = ["feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor", "review-catch"]
+BUILD = {"feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
+ALLOW = {"python3", "pytest", "bats", "bash", "node", "npx"}
+KNOWN_TASK_TYPES = {"all", "build", "review-catch", "feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
+MOUNT_OWNED = (".claude", "CLAUDE.md", ".loa.config.yaml", "grimoires", ".run")
+REQUIRED = ["id", "schema_version", "type", "source", "post_cutoff", "fixture", "criterion",
+            "success_criterion", "test_command", "regression_command", "reference_patch",
+            "grader_protected", "structural_check", "bounds", "review_catch", "suite_version"]
+
+arms = [a for a in (suite.get("arms") or []) if isinstance(a, dict)]
+arm_ids = sorted({a.get("id") for a in arms if isinstance(a.get("id"), str)})
+for a in arms:
+    if a.get("absent") is True:
+        continue
+    tt = a.get("task_types")
+    if not isinstance(tt, list) or not tt:
+        bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} has no task_types list")
+        continue
+    for t in tt:
+        if t not in KNOWN_TASK_TYPES:
+            bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} task_types names unknown type '{t}'")
+suite_version = suite.get("suite_version")
+
+def rel_ok(p):
+    return isinstance(p, str) and p and not p.startswith("/") and ".." not in p.split("/") and "\\" not in p
+
+def is_str_list(v):
+    return isinstance(v, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in v)
+
+def read(p):
+    try:
+        return open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+
+prompt_texts = []
+if os.path.isdir(prompts_dir):
+    for f in sorted(os.listdir(prompts_dir)):
+        if f.endswith(".md"):
+            prompt_texts.append((f"phase-prompts/{f}", read(os.path.join(prompts_dir, f)) or ""))
+
+def leak_scan(tid, label, text, stems, defect_ids):
+    low = text.lower()
+    if "hidden" in low:
+        bad(tid, f"leak: {label} contains the string 'hidden'")
+    for s in stems:
+        if s and re.search(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" + re.escape(s.lower()) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])", low):
+            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names the grader file stem '{s}'")
+    for d in defect_ids:
+        if d in text:
+            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names defect id '{d}'")
+    m = re.search(r"\bD[0-9]{2}-", text)
+    if m:
+        bad(tid, f"leak: {label} carries a defect key pattern '{m.group(0)}'")
+    for a in arm_ids:
+        if re.search(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" + re.escape(a) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])", text):
+            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names arm id '{a}'")
+
+counts = {t: 0 for t in TYPES}
+seen = {}
+for line in open(tasks_tsv, encoding="utf-8"):
+    line = line.rstrip("\n")
+    if not line:
+        continue
+    group, name, tdir, jpath = line.split("\t")
+    tid = f"{group}/{name}"
+    if jpath == "-":
+        bad(tid, "no task.yaml"); continue
+    if jpath == "!":
+        bad(tid, "task.yaml is not a YAML mapping"); continue
+    t = json.load(open(jpath))
+    for k in REQUIRED:
+        if k not in t:
+            bad(tid, f"schema: missing field '{k}'")
+    if t.get("id") != name:
+        bad(tid, f"schema: id '{t.get('id')}' differs from the directory name")
+    if not isinstance(t.get("id"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}", t.get("id") or ""):
+        bad(tid, "schema: id must match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}")
+    elif t["id"] in seen:
+        bad(tid, f"schema: duplicate id (also {seen[t['id']]})")
+    else:
+        seen[t["id"]] = tid
+    if t.get("schema_version") != 1:
+        bad(tid, "schema: schema_version must be 1")
+    ttype = t.get("type")
+    if ttype not in TYPES:
+        bad(tid, f"schema: type '{ttype}' not in {'|'.join(TYPES)}")
+    elif group == "tasks":
+        counts[ttype] += 1
+    src = t.get("source")
+    if not isinstance(src, dict):
+        bad(tid, "schema: source must be a mapping")
+    else:
+        if not isinstance(src.get("kind"), str) or not src.get("kind"):
+            bad(tid, "schema: source.kind must be a non-empty string")
+        if not isinstance(src.get("date"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", src.get("date") or ""):
+            bad(tid, "schema: source.date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
+        for k in ("fix_commit", "base_commit"):
+            if k in src and src[k] is not None and not (isinstance(src[k], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{7,40}", src[k])):
+                bad(tid, f"schema: source.{k} must be a hex commit id")
+        for k in src:
+            if k not in ("kind", "date", "fix_commit", "base_commit", "bead", "origin"):
+                bad(tid, f"schema: source.{k} is not a known key")
+    if not isinstance(t.get("post_cutoff"), bool):
+        bad(tid, "schema: post_cutoff must be a boolean")
+    build = ttype in BUILD
+    fx = t.get("fixture")
+    fixture_dir = None
+    if fx is None:
+        if build:
+            bad(tid, "schema: fixture is required for build types")
+    elif not rel_ok(fx):
+        bad(tid, "schema: fixture must be a relative path inside the root")
+    elif not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(root, fx)):
+        bad(tid, f"schema: fixture directory not found: {fx}")
+    else:
+        fixture_dir = os.path.join(root, fx)
+        if build:
+            print(f"FIXTURE\t{tid}\t{fixture_dir}")
+    crit = t.get("criterion")
+    if not isinstance(crit, str) or not crit.strip():
+        bad(tid, "schema: criterion must be a non-empty string")
+        crit = ""
+    else:
+        if "/" in crit or re.search(r"\b[\w.-]+\.(py|sh|bats|js|ts|mjs|json|ya?ml|md|toml|cfg|ini|txt|patch)\b", crit):
+            bad(tid, "schema: criterion names a path or file (agent-facing behaviour only)")
+        if re.search(r"\btest_\w+", crit):
+            bad(tid, "schema: criterion names a test")
+    if not isinstance(t.get("success_criterion"), str) or not t.get("success_criterion", "").strip():
+        bad(tid, "schema: success_criterion must be a non-empty string")
+    for key in ("test_command", "regression_command"):
+        v = t.get(key)
+        if v is None:
+            if key == "test_command" and ttype != "review-catch":
+                bad(tid, "schema: test_command is required for build types")
+            continue
+        if not is_str_list(v) or not v:
+            bad(tid, f"schema: {key} must be a non-empty array of strings or null")
+        elif v[0] not in ALLOW:
+            bad(tid, f"allowlist: {key}[0] '{v[0]}' not in {'|'.join(sorted(ALLOW))}")
+    for key, must in (("reference_patch", ttype in ("bug-fix", "feature-build")), ("structural_check", ttype == "refactor")):
+        v = t.get(key)
+        if v is None:
+            if must:
+                bad(tid, f"schema: {key} is required for {ttype}")
+            continue
+        if not rel_ok(v) or not v.startswith("hidden/"):
+            bad(tid, f"schema: {key} must be a relative path under hidden/")
+        elif not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(tdir, v)):
+            bad(tid, f"schema: {key} not found: {v}")
+    gp = t.get("grader_protected")
+    if not isinstance(gp, list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in gp):
+        bad(tid, "schema: grader_protected must be an array of paths")
+    else:
+        for p in gp:
+            if not rel_ok(p):
+                bad(tid, f"schema: grader_protected path '{p}' is not a relative path inside the tree")
+            elif fixture_dir and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(fixture_dir, p)):
+                bad(tid, f"schema: grader_protected path '{p}' is not in the fixture")
+    bounds = t.get("bounds")
+    if not isinstance(bounds, dict) or set(bounds) != {"max_turns", "timeout_min"}:
+        bad(tid, "schema: bounds must be {max_turns: {}, timeout_min: {}}")
+    else:
+        for k in ("max_turns", "timeout_min"):
+            m = bounds[k]
+            if not isinstance(m, dict) or not all(isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool) and x > 0 for x in m.values()):
+                bad(tid, f"schema: bounds.{k} must map phases to positive integers")
+            elif any(p not in ("PLAN", "IMPLEMENT", "REVIEW", "FIX", "AUDIT", "BARE") for p in m):
+                bad(tid, f"schema: bounds.{k} names an unknown phase")
+    rc = t.get("review_catch")
+    defect_ids = []
+    if ttype == "review-catch":
+        if not isinstance(rc, dict):
+            bad(tid, "schema: review_catch {fixture, manifest} is required for review-catch")
+        else:
+            for k in rc:
+                if k not in ("fixture", "manifest", "labels"):
+                    bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.{k} is not a known key")
+            rf, rm = rc.get("fixture"), rc.get("manifest")
+            if not rel_ok(rf) or not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(repo, "evals", "fixtures", rf)):
+                bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.fixture not found under evals/fixtures: {rf}")
+            if not rel_ok(rm) or not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(repo, rm)):
+                bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.manifest not found: {rm}")
+            else:
+                try:
+                    defect_ids = [d.get("id") for d in json.load(open(os.path.join(repo, rm))).get("defects", []) if d.get("id")]
+                except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
+                    bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.manifest is not a defect manifest: {rm}")
+    elif rc is not None:
+        bad(tid, "schema: review_catch must be null for build types")
+    sv = t.get("suite_version")
+    if not isinstance(sv, int) or isinstance(sv, bool) or sv < 1:
+        bad(tid, "schema: suite_version must be a positive integer")
+    elif suite_version is not None and sv != suite_version:
+        bad(tid, f"schema: suite_version {sv} differs from the suite file's {suite_version}")
+
+    stems = []
+    hm = os.path.join(tdir, "hidden", "manifest.json")
+    if build:
+        if not os.path.isfile(hm):
+            bad(tid, "hidden: hidden/manifest.json is missing")
+        else:
+            try:
+                files = json.load(open(hm)).get("files")
+            except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
+                files = None
+            if not isinstance(files, list) or not files:
+                bad(tid, "hidden: manifest.json must be {\"files\": [{src, dest}, ...]}")
+            else:
+                for e in files:
+                    s_, d_ = (e or {}).get("src"), (e or {}).get("dest")
+                    if not rel_ok(s_) or not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(tdir, "hidden", s_)):
+                        bad(tid, f"hidden: manifest src not found under hidden/: {s_}")
+                    if not rel_ok(d_):
+                        bad(tid, f"hidden: manifest dest must be a relative path inside the tree: {d_}")
+                    elif d_.split("/")[0] in MOUNT_OWNED:
+                        bad(tid, f"hidden: manifest dest lands on a mount-owned path: {d_}")
+                    if isinstance(s_, str) and s_:
+                        stems.append(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(s_))[0])
+        sc = t.get("structural_check")
+        if isinstance(sc, str) and sc:
+            stems.append(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(sc))[0])
+        rp = t.get("reference_patch")
+        if isinstance(rp, str) and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(tdir, rp)):
+            for pl in (read(os.path.join(tdir, rp)) or "").splitlines():
+                m = re.match(r"^(?:\+\+\+|---) (?:[ab]/)?(\S+)", pl)
+                if m and m.group(1) != "/dev/null" and m.group(1).split("/")[0] in MOUNT_OWNED:
+                    bad(tid, f"fixture path rule: reference patch touches a mount-owned path: {m.group(1)}")
+    task_md = read(os.path.join(tdir, "TASK.md"))
+    if task_md is None:
+        bad(tid, "schema: TASK.md is missing")
+        task_md = ""
+    leak_scan(tid, "TASK.md", task_md, stems, defect_ids)
+    leak_scan(tid, "criterion", crit, stems, defect_ids)
+    for label, text in prompt_texts:
+        leak_scan(tid, label, text, stems, defect_ids)
+
+if not allow_partial:
+    for ty in TYPES:
+        if counts[ty] != 4:
+            bad("suite", f"counts: {counts[ty]} {ty} task(s) under tasks/, want 4 (pass --allow-partial before the freeze)")
+
+for o in out:
+    print(o)
+PY
+
+violations=0
+: > "$WORK/report.txt"
+while IFS= read -r line; do
+  if [[ "$line" == FIXTURE$'\t'* ]]; then
+    IFS=$'\t' read -r _ tid fdir <<<"$line"
+    if ! check_fixture_path_rule "$fdir" 2>"$WORK/rule.err"; then
+      printf '%s: fixture path rule: %s\n' "$tid" "$(tr '\n' ' ' < "$WORK/rule.err" | sed 's/ *$//')" >> "$WORK/report.txt"
+    fi
+  else
+    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$WORK/report.txt"
+  fi
+done < "$WORK/out.txt"
+violations="$(grep -c . "$WORK/report.txt" || true)"
+ntasks="$(grep -c . "$WORK/tasks.tsv" || true)"
+if [[ "$violations" -gt 0 ]]; then
+  cat "$WORK/report.txt"
+  echo "validate-suite: $violations violation(s) over $ntasks task(s) in $ROOT" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+echo "validate-suite: OK — $ntasks task(s) valid in $ROOT$([[ "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" == "true" ]] && echo " (partial: type counts not enforced)")"
+exit 0

--- /dev/null

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# fingerprint.sh — toolchain fingerprint for ablation runs (cycle-130 FR-4, SDD A11 / DEC-0389)
+#
+# Prints `fp:<sha256>` over the LC_ALL=C-sorted `tool=version` lines of the
+# toolchain an ablation run depends on (claude, codex, python3, node, yq, jq,
+# bats, git, docker) plus `source_tree=<HEAD of --source-tree>`. A tool that is
+# not installed reads `tool=absent`, so a missing tool changes the fingerprint
+# instead of failing the run. The value fills `image_digest` in host mode and
+# `fingerprint` in every mode (MANIFEST.json, pipeline.json, runs.jsonl). It reads the
+# HOST toolchain: in container mode the phases run on the image's toolchain, and the
+# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host
+# CLI was 2.1.300 while Dockerfile.ablation pins 2.1.299).
+#
+# Usage:
+#   fingerprint.sh [--source-tree DIR] [--claude-bin B] [--bats-bin B] [--json]
+#
+# Options:
+#   --source-tree DIR  the pinned Loa tree; its `git rev-parse HEAD` is folded in
+#                      (`none` when absent or not a git tree)
+#   --claude-bin B     the CLI executable (default: $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
+#   --bats-bin B       bats executable (default: bats on PATH, else the operator's
+#                      ~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats)
+#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead
+#
+# Exit codes:
+#   0  printed
+#   2  usage error
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (fingerprint cases).
+# =============================================================================
+set -euo pipefail
+export LC_ALL=C
+
+# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
+# "Validate grader trust boundary").
+
+SOURCE_TREE=""
+CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
+BATS_BIN="${LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN:-}"
+JSON=false
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --source-tree) SOURCE_TREE="${2:?--source-tree needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --claude-bin)  CLAUDE_BIN="${2:?--claude-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --bats-bin)    BATS_BIN="${2:?--bats-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --json)        JSON=true; shift ;;
+    -h|--help)     sed -n '2,28p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
+    *) echo "fingerprint.sh: unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
+  esac
+done
+if [[ -z "$BATS_BIN" ]]; then
+  if command -v bats >/dev/null 2>&1; then BATS_BIN=bats
+  else BATS_BIN="$HOME/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats"; fi
+fi
+
+# first line of `<bin> <args>`, whitespace collapsed; `absent` when not runnable
+tool_version() {  # tool_version <bin> <args...>
+  local bin="$1"; shift
+  if ! command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ ! -x "$bin" ]]; then printf 'absent'; return 0; fi
+  local out
+  out="$("$bin" "$@" 2>&1 < /dev/null || true)"
+  out="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n '1p' | tr -s ' \t' ' ' | sed 's/^ //; s/ $//')"
+  [[ -n "$out" ]] || out="unknown"
+  printf '%s' "$out"
+}
+
+lines="$(
+  {
+    printf 'claude=%s\n'  "$(tool_version "$CLAUDE_BIN" --version)"
+    printf 'codex=%s\n'   "$(tool_version codex --version)"
+    printf 'python3=%s\n' "$(tool_version python3 --version)"
+    printf 'node=%s\n'    "$(tool_version node --version)"
+    printf 'yq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version yq --version)"
+    printf 'jq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version jq --version)"
+    printf 'bats=%s\n'    "$(tool_version "$BATS_BIN" --version)"
+    printf 'git=%s\n'     "$(tool_version git --version)"
+    printf 'docker=%s\n'  "$(tool_version docker --version)"
+  } | LC_ALL=C sort
+)"
+src="none"
+if [[ -n "$SOURCE_TREE" ]]; then
+  src="$(git -C "$SOURCE_TREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
+fi
+lines="$lines"$'\n'"source_tree=$src"
+digest="$(printf '%s\n' "$lines" | python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(sys.stdin.buffer.read()).hexdigest())')"
+fp="fp:$digest"
+
+if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
+  printf '%s\n' "$lines" | jq -Rn --arg fp "$fp" --arg src "$src" '
+    [inputs | select(length > 0)] as $l
+    | {fingerprint: $fp, source_tree: $src, lines: $l,
+       tools: ($l | map(select(startswith("source_tree=") | not) | capture("^(?<k>[^=]+)=(?<v>.*)$") | {(.k): .v}) | add)}'
+else
+  printf '%s\n' "$fp"
+fi

     5	# Prints `fp:<sha256>` over the LC_ALL=C-sorted `tool=version` lines of the
